jobs.title: BFC Senior Credit Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Job Description The Senior Credit Analyst plays a critical role across the full credit lifecycle — from underwriting and structuring individual transactions to managing syndication and funding-partner relationships to advancing the analytical tools and processes that support Beacon's credit decisioning.
jobs.description:
Job Description
The Senior Credit Analyst plays a critical role across the full credit lifecycle — from underwriting and structuring individual transactions to managing syndication and funding-partner relationships to advancing the analytical tools and processes that support Beacon's credit decisioning. This role combines the transaction-level judgment of a seasoned underwriter with the data and process orientation of a credit analytics specialist, and may include mentoring or providing working guidance to junior credit analysts as part of day-to-day deal flow.
Job Responsibilities
  • Review, evaluate, and adjudicate a high volume of daily commercial credit submissions, including financial statement analysis, collateral evaluation, and business history review
  • Recommend appropriate risk-based pricing and deal structure; direct, coordinate, and make recommendations for lease approvals
  • Conduct background investigation including bank, finance company, and trade references, and confirmation of revenue sources
  • Identify transactions to be funded via Beacon's portfolio or third-party funding partners, and manage a pipeline of “in credit” transactions in a timely manner
  • Assist in the underwriting of portfolio acquisitions and/or portfolio sales
  • Maintain working familiarity with Beacon's core industry assets and business borrowers
  • Manage and grow relationships with Beacon's syndicate bank and funding partners
  • Negotiate improved financing terms and conditions with syndication and funding partners
  • Identify and establish new syndication bank programs and funding partnerships
  • Assist in the development and ongoing enhancement of corporate credit scoring strategy and credit policy manual
  • Build and maintain dashboards, alerts, and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) to monitor key credit and portfolio performance indicators
  • Independently research and recommend asset classes, credit tools, systems, and data sources to improve underwriting and support new business generation
  • Analyze credit data and portfolio performance to identify underwriting trends, risks, and opportunities, and translate findings into clearly defined, implementable strategies and rules
  • Maintain credit standards and monitor industry regulations, requirements, trends, and competitor activity to ensure ongoing compliance
  • Present credit analytics findings and recommendations to senior management, and work closely with executives on credit policy and credit decisions
  • Effectively communicate with sales staff to facilitate deal flow, and assist in establishing payment terms and procedures with new vendor referral relationships
  • Collaborate with data analysts and application developers to build, fix, and enhance credit underwriting technology and reporting platforms
  • Foster effective teamwork across credit, sales, accounting, documentation, and collections
  • Provide working guidance and mentorship to junior credit analysts as needed; contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment
  • Participate in project management alongside cross-functional business partners on new initiatives, prioritization, and delivery
Job Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business, or a related field
  • 5+ years of combined experience in credit underwriting, portfolio management, and/or credit analytics, ideally with a bank, finance company, or leasing company
  • Business and/or four (4) year college degree is preferred
  • Experience with small-ticket, construction, and/or commercial vehicle equipment finance is a plus
  • Advanced knowledge of loans, leasing, credit analysis, underwriting, and deal structuring
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify risks, trends, and opportunities from data, and translate analysis into actionable strategy
  • Proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau) and strong general computer skills
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, leadership, and verbal/written communication skills; comfortable engaging with senior management
  • Proactive self-starter with a positive, can-do attitude and sound organizational and time-management skills
Benefits
  • Competitive base salary plus bonus opportunity
  • Flextime earned for additional hours worked over 8 hour days
  • 401(K) Matching Plan
  • Company Profit Sharing Plan
  • Medical, dental & vision insurance (UnitedHealthcare medical plan)
  • 14 Days off beginning after 30 days of employment
  • Employer that is a recognized market leader in the use of credit and underwriting technology

jobs.description:
Senior EA to act as Kelly's right hand across two growing businesses. High trust, high autonomy, real judgment required.

$2,500-$3,000/month | Full-time | Eastern Europe/South AfricaWe have two businesses, operating in Peru and the US. Harkened/Fibras Unidas is a B2B knitwear manufacturing operation in Lima, now largely managed by a general manager. The Endery is a clothing brand that started in e-commerce and has expanded into wholesale, and now includes a physical presence in both Lima and the US. The team includes full-time employees, contractors, and fractional specialists across both countries.

The businesses have grown organically, but the systems haven't always kept pace. Too much still funnels back to Kelly - information, follow-up, cross-functional coordination, and one-off decisions. This hire will help to reallocate some of the responsibilities, and will be a long-term right hand to Kelly - providing continuity as things evolve. The EA will deeply understand how Kelly works, know the team/who owns what, create structure where needed, route work effectively, and make sure tasks that have been delegated are completed. The EA will be trusted to operate independently - absorbing context, exercising judgment, turning messy inputs into organized action, and attempting to only bring Kelly in when absolutely necessary.

We're looking for a Senior Executive Assistant. Someone who has already had a senior career and now wants a high-trust, high-autonomy right-hand role rather than climbing a traditional corporate ladder. You'll act as the central nervous system across the 2 businesses and their founder’s day-to-day life - the person who makes everything run smoothly.

📋 Own founder’s inbox and calendar, triaging incoming requests and handling or routing as much as possible

🤝 Act as connective tissue across the businesses - understand who owns what, get the right people talking to each other, and land work with the most effective person

✅ Close loops by tracking requests, commitments and action items until they're completed

💡 Prepare decisions and meetings so I receive distilled information, recommendations and clearly defined choices rather than raw problems

📦 Build and maintain systems that make the businesses easier to run - Notion, SOPs, Google Drive, recurring calendars and checklists

📊 Maintain oversight of recurring administrative and business-critical areas like compliance deadlines, benefits, trademarks, expenses, subscriptions, travel and other operational details

🎯 Support cross-functional and special projects by coordinating internal team members, contractors and outside experts

🧠 Learn founder’s working style and the businesses deeply enough to increasingly anticipate needs and handle issues independently

Working hours are roughly 6am-2pm New York time (midday-8pm in Eastern Europe/South Africa).

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you need:

✅ Proper Senior EA experience - Senior EA, Executive Business Partner, Chief of Staff/EA hybrid, or similarly high-ownership executive support experience (not a low-level VA)

✅ Excellent judgment - able to distinguish what you can decide independently, what should be delegated to someone else, and what genuinely needs exec’s attention

✅ Confidence to step in and make decisions with the information you have and keep things moving forward

✅ Comfort operating with ambiguity - able to take a messy or incomplete request, figure out what's actually needed, and create a path forward

✅ Strong attention to detail

✅ Comfort managing people laterally - chasing and following up with the wider team

✅ Self-motivated, self-starter approach - highly autonomous and comfortable working independently without frequent check-ins or reassurance

✅ Emotional steadiness and resilience - able to receive direct feedback, navigate pressure and interpersonal complexity, and remain calm and solutions-oriented

✅ Solid working knowledge of platforms, tech and AI tools

Brownie points for:

⭐ Some Spanish, or interest in learning Spanish (part of my inbox is in Spanish and my team is in Peru)

⭐ Start-Up background - someone who can bring 'this is how other companies do it' to the table

The ideal person is warm, kind and polite, but with get-things-done energy. Someone who fits the culture of the existing team - people who care about what they do and how they treat each other. Confident without being arrogant. Low-drama and emotionally stable. Thrives on getting their head down and doing the work with minimal check-ins. Success looks like one-line weekly emails I can quickly answer, not play-by-play updates. Things get done without requiring my time.

Benefits

What’s in it for you?

💼 Full-time

🌍 Fully remote

📍 Eastern Europe or South Africa

jobs.title: Field/Event Marketing & Community Relations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

About the Role

Reporting to the Associate Director, Demand Generation, this role owns everywhere Agility shows up live: the in-person tradeshow calendar, every webinar we host, our flagship annual virtual event, intimate executive gatherings, and the foundations of our practitioner community. Significant in-person event travel is part of the job — you should want that.

You are analytical by nature, because the tradeshow calendar is yours completely: analyzing past show results to rank what actually worked, selecting next year's shows with our heads of sales, and owning booth operations, sponsorships, and pre- and post-show strategy for every one. You are also genuinely creative — the customer dinner with the right music and entertainment, the booth mechanic that draws real traffic, whether that's candy or a hired barista. Memorable beats expensive.

Every virtual event is yours end to end. You run all of our webinars — including moderating in the background when needed — and our named monthly webinar series. You deliver Signal Day, our flagship annual virtual event, against honest targets (800 registrations, roughly 400 live attendees) with a defined pivot mechanism if registration tracks below the floor. Pre-event and post-event engagement arcs — for webinars and tradeshows alike — are designed with, and executed inside, the Associate Director's funnel architecture.

You put our research on stage. Our Director of Communications & Content owns two flagship research reports; you own the launch webinars and derivative live events that turn each report into a season of programming.

You also run our intimate executive formats — roundtables and dinners for Enterprise & Government audiences — which are our deliberate alternative to the mega-conference model: we win the room of twelve.

On community: you build the foundation. Our practitioner community and ambassador program start from audiences we already own — our webinar and event attendees, our awards entrants, and our strongest customer advocates — with engagement mechanics wired to Signal Day: challenges in the run-up, champion recognition, and VIP access as the reward. The year-one milestone is a named ambassador cohort of 15–25 passionate Agility users with a defined give-and-get, plus a presence in regional PR associations. Our publication's audience belongs to our content organization; you activate that audience live.

What Success Looks Like

  • The tradeshow portfolio is ranked by measured ROI, with data-driven recommendations to sales on next year's calendar.
  • Every show runs with a documented pre- and post-show engagement plan, and post-show analysis lands within two weeks.
  • The webinar program runs on cadence with pre- and post-event arcs, and you can run one solo — including background moderation — without drama.
  • Signal Day hits its registration and attendance targets, or the pivot mechanism executes cleanly and on time.
  • Both flagship research reports get full readout programming: launch webinar plus derivative live events.
  • The ambassador cohort of 15–25 is named, active, and wired to Signal Day mechanics by year end.
  • Every event — field or virtual — feeds pipeline measurably, and you can show which ones feed it best.

What you’ll do

Tradeshows & Field

  • Own the tradeshow calendar end to end: selection with sales leadership, budgets, sponsorships, booth operations, and logistics.
  • Analyze past show performance and rank the portfolio by return; recommend the calendar with data.
  • Design creative on-site experiences: customer dinners, entertainment, and booth-traffic mechanics that people remember.
  • Run pre- and post-show engagement strategy for every event.

Webinars & Flagship Virtual Event

  • Run every webinar Agility hosts end to end, including background moderation when needed.
  • Operate the named monthly webinar series on a reliable cadence.
  • Deliver Signal Day: registration drive, production, live operations, and the pivot decision process.
  • Execute pre- and post-event engagement arcs inside the demand generation funnel architecture.

Research Readouts & Executive Formats

  • Produce the launch webinar and derivative live events for each flagship research report.
  • Design and run executive roundtables and dinners for Enterprise & Government audiences.
  • Coordinate review-solicitation moments with product marketing at events.

Community & Ambassadors

  • Build the foundation of the practitioner community from owned audiences: event attendees, awards entrants, and customer advocates.
  • Stand up the ambassador program: recruit the 15–25 member cohort, define the give-and-get, and run the engagement mechanics wired to Signal Day.
  • Build Agility's presence in regional PR associations, riding the tradeshow calendar.

What You'll Bring

  • B2B event marketing experience spanning both in-person tradeshows and virtual events, ideally in SaaS.
  • An analytical spine: you measure event ROI, rank a portfolio, and recommend with data.
  • Proven virtual event production skill: platforms, run-of-show, moderation, and the calm to run it solo.
  • Creative experience design instincts, with examples of event moments that people remembered.
  • Exceptional organization under concurrency: multiple event timelines at different stages, all on track.
  • A proactive, sense-of-urgency working style — events do not wait, and neither do you.
  • Comfort with significant travel during show season.
  • Community-building or ambassador program experience an asset.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Collaborative culture – and key tools enabling it
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Health, Dental & Vision benefits
  • RRSP matching
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career Development & Progression opportunities
  • Paid Vacation, Personal Days and Sick days
  • Flex Fridays in Summer, Week off between Christmas and New Years'
  • No Internal Meetings Fridays

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is C$80,000–C$110,000 annually, plus a target bonus of 12–15%. Final compensation will reflect the successful candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity.

This is a new position.

AI Usage

We use technology to make hiring smarter, faster, and more personal, never less human. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools help us manage applications efficiently and highlight qualifications that align with each role, allowing our recruiters to focus more on meaningful conversations with candidates. AI does not make hiring decisions at Agility. Every decision is made by people, our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are trained to apply sound judgment and equitable practices at every stage. jobs.description:
ABOUT CHANGING LIVES PRODUCTIONS:

Changing Lives Productions is the in-house video production company of Dhar Mann Studios, the #1 creator of scripted positive content online. With over 163 million followers and 45+ billion views across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, our videos receive more than 1 billion views each month.

We produce several hours of original content weekly with messages of compassion, kindness, and altruism that resonate with viewers of all ages. Our stories tackle real-life challenges and deliver powerful life lessons that resonate with global audiences.

Founded by Dhar Mann, named the "Moral Philosopher of YouTube" by The New York Times, a Time Top 100 Creator, and ranked #2 on Forbes' 2025 Top Creators list - our founding principle is simple but ambitious: We're not just telling stories. We're changing lives.

BIG PICTURE:

Why This Role Matters: Too much important work still depends on someone remembering to do it. We are seeking an exceptionally resourceful, systems-oriented AI & Automation Operations Manager to design, improve, and manage the processes that support a fast-moving entrepreneur, family office, and administrative team. The objective is straightforward: build systems that make important work difficult to forget, difficult to drop, and easy to execute correctly.

This is not a traditional Administrative Assistant position. We already have team members who can execute tasks. This role steps back, evaluates how work is being done, and asks: Why does someone have to remember to do this? Why isn't there a reliable system for this? Can AI, automation, or better process design make this faster and more dependable? How do we make sure this process is still working six months from now?

The role combines AI implementation, automation, process design, systems management, and high-level administrative operations. It works in close partnership with the Admin Manager and administrative team as a systems and operational partner, strengthening the processes, tools, and infrastructure behind the administrative function rather than duplicating the Admin Manager's role.

HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME:

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient administrative work and determine where AI, automation, and better process design can improve speed, reliability, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Build automated workflows across administrative systems and tools so information moves automatically instead of relying on manual updates.
  • Create reminders, triggers, alerts, and escalation systems for overdue or time-sensitive tasks, and automate recurring reports, updates, and status communications.
  • Use AI to research, summarize, organize, draft, and analyze, and develop effective prompts, templates, and reusable AI workflows for the team.
  • Audit how recurring administrative responsibilities are currently handled and find where tasks, information, or follow-ups fall through the cracks.
  • Build and maintain SOPs, checklists, workflows, and operating procedures with clear ownership, deadlines, reminders, escalation paths, and quality control, so important work is verified rather than assumed.
  • Keep recurring processes (inventories, subscription and account reviews, invoice follow-ups, weekly, monthly, and quarterly administrative reviews) running reliably months after they are built, without depending on one person remembering every step.
  • Close loops on open tasks: track follow-ups, escalate when needed, and improve the process so the same bottleneck does not happen twice.
  • Partner with the Admin Manager on priorities, pain points, and process-improvement projects from problem identification through implementation, documentation, and follow-through.
  • Research and prepare concise summaries and recommendations to support administrative decision-making, and organize the trackers, databases, and documentation the team relies on.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools, train team members on the ones that are genuinely useful, and continuously find administrative work that can be simplified, automated, or eliminated.
  • Step in to support administrative work when necessary, always asking: should this require the same amount of manual effort next time?

WHAT YOU HAVE:

  • You naturally think in systems and processes. You do not just see tasks; you see the system behind them, and you want to simplify, streamline, or automate it.
  • Hands-on experience building real workflows with AI platforms (ChatGPT or similar), AI agents, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or n8n.
  • Working knowledge of Slack, Google Workspace, Airtable, Notion, project-management platforms (Asana, monday.com, ClickUp, or similar), forms, databases, dashboards, and reporting tools. APIs, webhooks, and spreadsheet automation are a plus.
  • Experience turning informal or inconsistent ways of working into SOPs and documented processes that teams actually follow.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong organization, and consistent follow-through. You document processes naturally and think through edge cases and failure points.
  • You work independently without constant direction, take initiative instead of waiting for permission, and are comfortable holding people accountable to agreed-upon processes.
  • You communicate clearly and concisely, balance speed with accuracy, and are resourceful when the answer is not immediately obvious.
  • Awareness of AI cost management, security, privacy, and access controls.
  • You do not need to be a software engineer, but when someone describes a repetitive administrative problem, your instinct is to start thinking about how to systemize it.

WHO OVERSEES YOU:

The AI & Automation Operations Manager reports to the Automation Lead. This role works in close partnership with the Admin Manager and administrative team as a systems and operational partner.

WHERE IT ALL GOES DOWN:

This role is fully remote, working from home or a personal office, supporting a distributed administrative team across time zones.

WHEN THE MAGIC HAPPENS:

The typical work schedule is 40 hours a week, Monday - Friday. Specific hours and timezone overlap will be discussed during the interview.

Salary: $12 to $15 /hr

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.description:
L'équipe Account Manager s'agrandit !

AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇

Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays, pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ce que tu feras :

En tant qu’Account Manager Full Cycle, tu occupes un rôle stratégique au sein de l’équipe commerciale et prends la responsabilité d’un portefeuille de clients existants.

Ta mission : développer durablement la valeur de ton portefeuille, en pilotant l’ensemble du cycle de vie client, de l’onboarding au renouvellement, en passant par l’adoption et l’expansion.

Ton rôle s’articule autour de trois priorités :

  • Sécuriser : anticiper les renouvellements, protéger le revenu récurrent et limiter le churn.

  • Développer : identifier et convertir les opportunités d’upsell et d’expansion pour faire croître l’ARR de ton portefeuille.

  • Accompagner : assurer l’onboarding, favoriser l’adoption et construire une relation client créatrice de valeur dans la durée.

Missions

Fidéliser & sécuriser ton portefeuille

  • Piloter ton portefeuille dans une logique de rétention et de développement du revenu récurrent.

  • Identifier les risques de désengagement et mettre en place les actions nécessaires pour prévenir le churn.

  • Anticiper les échéances contractuelles et piloter les renouvellements suffisamment en amont.

  • Mener les négociations de renouvellement en sécurisant le revenu et en favorisant, lorsque cela est pertinent, des engagements à plus long terme.

  • Suivre la santé de tes comptes grâce aux données d’usage, aux niveaux d’engagement et aux différents signaux clients.

Développer l’ARR de ton portefeuille

  • Identifier et convertir les opportunités d’upsell et d’expansion : nouveaux utilisateurs, extension de périmètre, fonctionnalités, formations ou services complémentaires.

  • Construire des stratégies de développement adaptées au potentiel et aux enjeux de chaque compte.

  • Transformer les signaux d’usage et d’adoption en opportunités commerciales concrètes.

  • Piloter tes opportunités d’expansion de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la négociation et au closing.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes BDR et Marketing pour maximiser le potentiel de développement de ton portefeuille.

  • Prendre en charge et développer les nouveaux comptes qui te sont attribués.

Onboarder & accélérer l’adoption

  • Piloter l’onboarding des nouveaux clients autour de leurs cas d’usage, objectifs et KPIs de succès.

  • Définir les premiers jalons permettant aux clients de percevoir rapidement la valeur d’AssessFirst.

  • Favoriser l’activation et la récurrence d’usage dès les 30 à 60 premiers jours.

  • Assurer une transition fluide entre l’onboarding et la gestion long terme du compte.

Créer et démontrer de la valeur

  • Comprendre les enjeux business et RH de tes clients pour faire évoluer leur utilisation d’AssessFirst.

  • Les accompagner dans la traduction de leurs usages en résultats business mesurables.

  • Animer des Success Reviews régulières pour valoriser les résultats obtenus et identifier les prochaines opportunités.

  • Renforcer la perception de valeur tout au long de la relation, notamment en préparation des renouvellements et des discussions d’expansion.

  • Adopter une véritable posture de conseil, capable de challenger et d’accompagner les clients dans leurs enjeux.

Piloter ton activité & ton portefeuille

  • Être l’interlocuteur privilégié des clients de ton portefeuille et garantir un suivi régulier, structuré et proactif.

  • Maintenir un reporting fiable sur les renouvellements, opportunités d’expansion, risques et forecasts.

  • Piloter tes indicateurs de performance et ajuster tes plans d’action lorsque nécessaire.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote, United States. Core availability 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern, Monday through Friday.

Type: Full time, salaried.

Eligibility: U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident.

The role

This is the analytical center of the contract and the face of it to the client. When a comment period closes on a proposed Packers and Stockyards Act rule, you are the person who reads what the public sent in, works out what actually matters in it, and turns thousands of pages into something the agency's policy staff can use to write a final rule.

Between rulemakings you run the contract: the deliverable tracking, the monthly reporting, the weekly client meetings, and the readiness work that makes the next sprint survivable. You will also direct the analyst bench during comment closes, setting the coding scheme and reviewing what comes back.

The turnaround is fifteen calendar days from the close of the comment period for both the substantive analysis and the key issues matrix, and the client has signaled they may want it faster. This job suits someone who does careful work quickly and does not need to be managed through a deadline.

Analysis and writing

  • Analyze public comments submitted on proposed rules, identifying themes, high-risk issues, quantitative metrics such as comment counts by topic, recommendations from the public, and the line between substantive and non-substantive submissions.
  • Distinguish organized form-letter campaigns from unique substantive comments and account for both in the analysis.
  • Identify every issue raised through public comment and build the key issues matrix, with comments sorted and categorized by issue for policy discussion and for drafting written responses in the final rule.
  • Write summaries that hold up under legal and policy review and that support the agency's response obligations under the Administrative Procedure Act.
  • Deliver written material that meets federal, and preferably USDA, style guidance and Section 508 accessibility requirements.
  • Set the coding scheme for each rulemaking and review the analyst bench's output against it.

Running the contract

  • Maintain a one-page deliverable tracking sheet, updated weekly and submitted electronically to the client throughout the contract.
  • Lead the kick-off meeting within ten business days of award and develop the project plan that follows from it.
  • Write and submit monthly progress reports to the Contracting Officer's Representative covering technical progress, schedule status, and any concerns or recommendations.
  • Run weekly virtual status meetings with the client on comment volume, processing progress, schedule risk, and emerging themes, and document decisions in internal meeting notes.
  • Forecast comment volume as it accumulates and tell Connexus early how much bench support each close will need.
  • Escalate anything that looks like scope creep to Connexus management rather than absorbing it.

What you need

  • Bachelor's degree. Advanced degree in public policy, law, economics, agricultural economics, or a related field is welcome.
  • Thorough working understanding of the federal notice-and-comment rulemaking process and the Administrative Procedure Act.
  • Direct experience analyzing or responding to public comments on a federal rulemaking, whether at an agency, a contractor, a law firm, or a trade association.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of federal regulatory and stylistic requirements for public comment processing and rulemaking.
  • Strong analytical writing. You will be asked for a writing sample.
  • Familiarity with the Federal Document Management System and regulations.gov.
  • Experience producing Section 508 compliant documents.
  • Comfortable owning a client relationship, including writing status reports a federal reviewer will read closely.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, Zoom, and Adobe Acrobat Pro.

Nice to have

  • USDA experience, particularly with AMS, or familiarity with the Packers and Stockyards Act and livestock and poultry markets.
  • Experience with high-volume comment dockets and mass-comment campaigns.
  • Prior work directing junior analysts on deadline.
  • Working knowledge of qualitative coding or text analysis tooling.
Salary: $95K+ DOE

jobs.excerpt: Job Family Group: Retail GroupJob Description: The Field Merchandiser is responsible for the hands-on execution of merchandising initiatives across TA locations.
jobs.description:
Job Family Group:

Retail Group

Job Description:

The Field Merchandiser is responsible for the hands-on execution of merchandising initiatives across TA locations. This position works as part of a traveling field team responsible for completing store resets, reflows, cooler resets and refreshes, remodel support, fixture changes, planogram implementation, promotional execution, backroom and storage organization, and other merchandising projects.

The Field Merchandiser may also assist with the reflow and remerchandising of deli and sales desk areas to improve product presentation, space utilization, customer experience, and operational efficiency.

This is a highly physical, hands-on role requiring frequent travel and the ability to work effectively in an active retail environment. Field Merchandisers will be expected to move merchandise, tear down and rebuild fixtures, stock and organize product, install merchandising materials, and ensure stores are completed according to approved layouts, planograms, merchandising standards, and BP safety requirements.

This role is 50 hours per week.

Key Responsibilities

Safety

  • Follow all BP and TA safety policies, procedures, and protocols at all times.

  • Complete required safety training and utilize required personal protective equipment (PPE).

  • Maintain a safe work environment for team members, store employees, customers, and vendors throughout each project.

  • Follow proper lifting, material-handling, ladder, equipment, cooler, and fixture-installation procedures.

  • Immediately identify and report unsafe conditions, damaged equipment, injuries, or other safety concerns.

  • Maintain clean and organized work areas during resets and leave stores safe and customer-ready at the completion of each workday.

Store Resets & Fixture Installation

  • Participate in complete and partial store resets, reflows, remodels, and merchandising refreshes.

  • Tear down, move, assemble, rebuild, level, and position retail fixtures and shelving according to approved store layouts.

  • Remove and reinstall shelves, peg hooks, displays, racks, endcaps, merchandising accessories, and other store fixtures.

  • Safely move product and fixtures throughout the store as required to complete resets.

  • Assist with receiving, staging, organizing, and installing new fixtures and merchandising materials.

  • Identify damaged or missing fixtures, components, or supplies and communicate issues quickly to the appropriate project leader.

Cooler Resets & Refreshes

  • Complete cooler resets, reflows, and merchandising refreshes according to approved layouts and planograms.

  • Remove, stage, organize, and replace refrigerated merchandise as necessary to complete cooler resets.

  • Adjust shelves, product placement, facings, and merchandising organization within coolers according to approved plans.

  • Assist with reorganizing cooler space to improve product presentation, shopability, inventory capacity, and replenishment.

  • Identify damaged shelving, fixtures, tags, signage, or other cooler-related merchandising issues and communicate them to project leadership.

  • Coordinate cooler work with store management to minimize product exposure and disruption to normal store operations.

Planogram & Layout Execution

  • Read, understand, and accurately execute approved store layouts, floor plans, planograms, cooler layouts, and merchandising instructions.

  • Set shelves, fixtures, products, and displays to the specifications provided.

  • Ensure correct product placement, facings, shelf heights, spacing, sequencing, and merchandising presentation.

  • Validate that completed sections match approved planograms and layouts.

  • Identify situations where store conditions prevent proper execution and call out those issues rather than making unauthorized changes.

  • Support field validation of new layouts and planograms and provide feedback when execution challenges are identified.

Backroom, Storage & Cooler Organization

  • Assist with the organization and improvement of backrooms, storage areas, coolers, and other inventory holding areas as part of store reset and reflow projects.

  • Organize inventory to improve accessibility, replenishment, inventory visibility, and overall store efficiency.

  • Help identify excess, obsolete, discontinued, damaged, or misplaced merchandise and follow established procedures for disposition.

  • Organize merchandising supplies, fixtures, shelving, signage, and other materials to improve store-level execution.

  • Help establish sustainable organization standards that store teams can maintain after the Field Merchandising team leaves.

  • Ensure backroom, storage, and cooler areas are left clean, organized, safe, and operationally functional.

Deli & Sales Desk Reflow Support

  • Assist with the reflow, reorganization, and remerchandising of deli and sales desk areas as directed by approved project plans.

  • Move and reposition merchandise, displays, shelving, racks, and other approved fixtures to support revised layouts.

  • Assist with improving product placement, customer flow, visibility, impulse merchandising, and overall presentation in these areas.

  • Support the merchandising of food, beverage, grab-and-go, impulse, and other approved products associated with deli and sales desk areas.

  • Install appropriate signage, shelf tags, promotional materials, and merchandising communication.

  • Work closely with store teams and appropriate functional partners to minimize disruption to deli, sales desk, and customer operations.

Product Merchandising

  • Remove product from existing fixtures and properly stage merchandise during resets.

  • Restock and merchandise products following completion of fixture, cooler, and Planogram work.

  • Identify discontinued, damaged, excess, misplaced, or non-planogrammed inventory and follow established procedures for disposition.

  • Ensure merchandise is properly faced, organized, priced, and presented before completing a project.

  • Install shelf tags, price labels, promotional signage, displays, endcap materials, and other merchandising communication.

  • Help ensure promotional and seasonal programs are implemented according to established standards.

Store & Team Support

  • Work collaboratively with store management and team members while minimizing disruption to customers and normal store operations.

  • Communicate project progress, execution issues, missing materials, inventory concerns, and other barriers to Field Merchandising leadership.

  • Assist store teams in understanding new layouts, cooler sets, merchandising standards, organization expectations, and other changes following a reset.

  • Maintain a professional attitude and represent BP/TA appropriately when interacting with store employees, customers, vendors, and other partners.

  • Support other field merchandising and retail execution initiatives as business needs require.

Physical Requirements

This position requires significant physical activity. Team members must be able to:

  • Regularly lift, carry, push, and pull merchandise, fixtures, shelving, equipment, and supplies.

  • Lift and move heavy objects, including items weighing up to 50 pounds independently, and heavier items with appropriate assistance or equipment.

  • Bend, kneel, squat, reach, climb, and work at varying heights throughout the workday.

  • Safely use ladders and approved material-handling equipment when required.

  • Stand and walk for extended periods, including the majority of a work shift.

  • Perform repetitive lifting, stocking, fixture assembly, cooler resets, and merchandising activities.

  • Work for reasonable periods in refrigerated cooler environments when completing cooler resets or organization.

  • Work safely in active retail environments that may include customers, deliveries, contractors, and ongoing store operations.

Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law.

Travel & Scheduling Requirements

  • Frequent travel is required, including weekly and overnight travel.

  • Must be able to travel by automobile and commercial airline as business needs require.

  • Must be able to work at TA locations throughout the United States.

  • Must maintain scheduling flexibility based on project and store requirements.

  • Work schedules may include early mornings, evenings, overnight work, and occasional weekends depending on project needs.

  • Team members are expected to coordinate travel with other Field Merchandising team members when appropriate to improve efficiency and control travel costs.

Qualifications

  • Previous retail, merchandising, store operations, construction/fixture installation, warehouse, or related experience preferred.

  • Experience completing retail resets or working from planograms and store layouts strongly preferred.

  • Experience with cooler resets, inventory organization, or convenience/travel center merchandising is a plus.

  • Ability to read and accurately follow detailed instructions, layouts, diagrams, and planograms.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to execution standards.

  • Ability to perform physically demanding work safely and consistently.

  • Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a traveling team.

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to adapt quickly when field conditions differ from plans while escalating decisions appropriately.

  • Valid driver's license and ability to meet applicable company travel requirements.

Measures of Success

Success in the Field Merchandiser role will be measured by:

  • Safety – Work is completed without compromising BP/TA safety standards.

  • Accuracy – Store layouts, cooler layouts, and planograms are executed correctly.

  • Quality – Fixtures, merchandise, pricing, signage, coolers, backrooms, and storage areas meet established standards.

  • Productivity – Projects are completed efficiently and within established timelines.

  • Consistency – Execution standards are maintained from location to location.

  • Organization – Backrooms, storage areas, coolers, and merchandising supplies are left organized and easier for store teams to manage.

  • Teamwork – Works effectively with fellow Field Merchandisers, store teams, and project leadership.

  • Cost Awareness – Uses company resources responsibly and coordinates travel and project activities efficiently.

  • Store Readiness – Locations are left clean, organized, safe, operationally functional, and ready to serve customers following completion of the work.

Role Expectations

The Field Merchandiser is expected to take ownership of execution. The role requires individuals who are willing to roll up their sleeves and physically complete the work, while maintaining high standards for safety, accuracy, speed, organization, and store presentation.

The scope of the role extends beyond simply resetting shelves. Field Merchandisers may work across the sales floor, coolers, backrooms, storage areas, deli, sales desk, and other customer-facing merchandising areas to help create a more effective overall store.

The objective is not simply to complete a reset. The objective is to leave each location safer, easier to shop, easier to replenish, better organized, easier for the store team to operate, and fully aligned with the approved merchandising strategy.

Job Title: Sr. Digital Product Manager, Forecasting

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Sr. Digital Product Manager, Forecasting

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will lead the strategy, discovery, development, and adoption of high-impact digital products that improve how Amgen forecasts, plans, evaluates scenarios, and makes complex business decisions. You will work at the intersection of business strategy, customer needs, data science, and technology to translate sophisticated analytical capabilities into intuitive, trusted, and scalable products.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Translate Amgen’s digital strategy into product visions, roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer decisions, workflows, assumptions, and planning challenges across Commercial, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and R&D.
  • Frame complex and ambiguous business problems as product opportunities, identifying where forecasting, optimization, simulation, scenario planning, automation, or AI-enabled decision support can improve outcomes.
  • Partner with business leaders, data scientists, engineers, architects, and designers to translate analytical methods and models into scalable and usable digital products.
  • Ensure forecasting and decision-support products make assumptions, uncertainty, tradeoffs, and model outputs understandable and actionable, with appropriate monitoring of model performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Influence senior stakeholders, reconcile competing priorities, and align cross-functional teams around a shared product vision, roadmap, and measures of success.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate generative AI, agentic capabilities, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation while supporting responsible AI, transparency, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Establish effective operating rhythms, decision rights, documentation, and communication practices for globally distributed teams.
  • Drive product adoption and value realization by measuring impact on business performance, efficiency, decision-making, and user experience.
  • Mentor product managers and contribute to an outcome-oriented product culture across Amgen.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. In this role, you will serve as the connective tissue between business strategy, customer needs, data science, and technology.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 2 years of Digital Product Management experience

OR

Master’s degree and 6 years of Digital Product Management experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Digital Product Management experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 10 years of Digital Product Management experience

OR

High school diploma / GED and 12 years of Digital Product Management experience

In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have a minimum of 2 years’ experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Product Management and Product Mindset
    • Proven digital product leader with experience connecting business strategy, customer needs, data and analytics, and technology.
    • Experience leading data-intensive, analytical, or decision-support products from discovery through launch, adoption, and scaling.
    • Demonstrated ability to translate complex decisions, planning processes, and analytical methods into compelling product strategies and intuitive customer experiences.
    • Strong customer-first and outcome-oriented mindset, balancing user needs, business value, data, and technical feasibility.
    • Experience applying Agile methods to multidisciplinary product, data science, and engineering teams.
    • Strong understanding of technology ecosystems, enterprise data platforms, and digital architecture principles.
  • Forecasting, Planning, and Decision Science
    • Experience developing products that incorporate forecasting, predictive analytics, optimization, simulation, scenario planning, machine learning, or other advanced analytical capabilities.
    • Ability to partner effectively with data scientists and technical teams, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate model outputs, uncertainty, and limitations to nontechnical stakeholders.
    • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare, consumer products, manufacturing, supply chain, or another complex planning environment is preferred.
  • Leadership and Interpersonal
    • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional product teams and drive execution without relying solely on formal authority.
    • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, navigate competing priorities, and create alignment in ambiguous environments.
    • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, including translating complex analytical and technical topics into clear business narratives.
    • Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
    • Experience mentoring product managers or other senior individual contributors and strengthening broader product management capabilities.

Senior Influencer Marketing Manager

Position: Full-Time

Location: This position offers remote work from California/Denver/New York. Please be aware that applications from candidates residing outside of California/Denver/New York will not be considered.

OVERVIEW

Movement Strategy is looking for a Senior Influencer Marketing Manager to lead and elevate our creator programs. You will report to the Director, Influencer Marketing, and work closely with our Creative, Organic Social, and Paid teams.

This is a strategic, data-informed, trend-obsessed, relationship-driven role. You'll sit at the bridge between brand strategy, creator talent, and creative production, translating client goals into native social concepts that actually land. You have a sharp, instinctive eye for what makes a great creator partner, looking past vanity metrics to evaluate audience authenticity, engagement health, creative versatility, and on-camera presence. If you know how to spot the right creator before the data catches up, and can turn a business goal into a brief that gets authentic, scroll-stopping content

A BIT ABOUT US

Movement Strategy creates content and campaigns for the world’s most exciting brands. We win awards, make headlines, shatter engagement numbers and celebrate the journey along the way. It’s why companies like Netflix, Amazon, Spotify, and Intuit come to us again and again.

We’re fully remote with hubs in New York, Denver, and LA, and a presence all across the US. We believe collaboration is what takes our work from good to great, and at times, even to legendary status. We champion diverse opinions and creativity in every department, and provide professional development and learning opportunities with the goal of helping you discover your best work today, and learn how to make it even better in the future.

KEY FOCUS AREAS

  • Creative Collaboration & Trend Foresight: 40%

    • Work hand-in-hand with Creative Directors to co-develop creator briefs, bridging scripted hero spots, native creator integrations, and product demos
    • Craft clear, inspiring briefs that give creators room to be authentic while guaranteeing client deliverables hit key messaging pillars
    • Continually monitor and report on emerging social trends, audio cues, storytelling formats, and platform features across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging channels
    • Spot high-value creator partners using an intuitive and data-backed approach, looking beyond follower counts to evaluate voice, brand alignment, and on-camera presence
    • Analyze visual and messaging performance data to feed creative insights back to talent and the internal team

    Campaign Strategy & Execution: 40%

    • Develop, implement, and scale holistic influencer strategies spanning top-of-funnel awareness down to performance-driven affiliate, spark ads, and whitelisting tactics, in partnership with Paid Social
    • Manage comprehensive campaign lifecycles across multiple accounts: outreach, rate negotiations, contract execution (exclusivity, usage rights), content review, publishing, and FTC compliance
    • Manage influencer program budgets, track key metrics (EMV, CPA, ROAS, Engagement), and deliver performance reports to stakeholders
    • Maintain relationships with talent, agencies, and creator managers to build a growing network of long-term ambassadors

    Production & Producer Collaboration: 20%

    • Work alongside agency Producers to plan, schedule, and execute creator shoots across creator-shot and agency-produced/studio environments
    • Understand shoot mechanics, call sheets, deliverable specs, talent usage rights, and multi-timeline production workflows from pre- through post-production
    • Serve as the influencer subject matter expert on set, ensuring talent is comfortable, on-brief, and delivering natural, native-feeling performances

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience & Background

    • 5 to 7 years of dedicated experience in influencer marketing, creator strategy, or social-first content production
    • Prior agency experience (advertising, marketing, or PR) strongly preferred
    • Hands-on experience working alongside agency Producers, video production teams, and in live shoot or studio environments

    Trend & Platform Literacy

    • Deep knowledge of platform-specific content mechanics (TikTok visual hooks, Reel dynamics, YouTube Shorts pacing)
    • Experience with creator platforms (e.g., CreatorIQ, Grin, Aspire, Traackr, LTK) and social analytics tools

    Business & Negotiation Savvy

    • Proven track record negotiating usage rights (whitelisting/dark posting), exclusivity terms, and performance-based contracts

    Communication & Relationship Building

    • Exceptional storytelling, briefing, and interpersonal skills to seamlessly liaise between internal creative teams, agency producers, and external creators

    Nice to have

    • Hands-on content creation: ability to directly create, produce, and/or edit social-forward content
    • Technical production knowledge: understanding of the mechanics and nuances of content production and experience working within these environments

IDEAL QUALITIES

  • High energy, passionate, curious, confident, and tenacious in learning, coupled with the ability to navigate the nuances of different client teams.
  • You have an overall understanding of today’s fast-paced social media landscape and have a strong personal interest and knowledge of both leading and next-up influential creatives in the social media space.
  • You’re proactive and naturally curious about the digital and social space, constantly looking for opportunities to evolve the department and advance the work.
  • You’re up to speed on current pop culture and industry trends whether it’s the latest functionality rolling out on TikTok or the next viral meme on the Internet.
  • You exercise both your left and right brains, in that you are both creative and strategic.
  • You’re a skilled communicator with an inquisitive and enthusiastic attitude—ready to learn fast, absorb information fast, and implement fast!
  • You’re innately resourceful when it comes to mining for information and you’re accustomed to always thinking ahead in life.
  • You are a nimble self-starter and quickly adjust to internal and external teams in an ever-changing environment; identify opportunity with bias to action.
  • You have a diverse and inclusive perspective, valuing different viewpoints and backgrounds within the team.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Movement Strategy’s approach to the future of work: We embrace a remote culture and empower our employees to work wherever they feel most productive. To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have a partnership with WeWork which allows our employees to have a membership to any location nationwide. We recruit in our three main states of California, Colorado, and New York.

As a leader in social advertising, we rely on the creativity of our people to deliver the best work for our clients. In return, we invest in our employees by offering them a diverse suite of benefits from best-in-class carriers, with enough choice and flexibility to keep our team and their families healthy and happy today and tomorrow.

  • 100% employer contribution for health (base plan), vision, and dental
  • 401K Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Short and Long Term Disability
  • Life Insurance & AD&D
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Fully-Remote Agency
  • Flexible Unlimited Paid Time Off
    • Take-As-You-Need Paid Time Off
    • Take-As-You-Need Paid Mental Health Days
    • 10 days minimum required off per year
  • Company Paid Holidays and More
  • Week-Long Winter Agency Closure
  • Support for continued education
  • New Business Referral Bonus
  • Movement Journey Program - Stipend for personal growth
  • Health and Wellness Program
  • WeWork Membership
  • Positive Impact and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) Committees
  • Employee Resource Groups

SALARY & COMPENSATION

In compliance with local and state law, we are disclosing the compensation for roles that will be performed in New York City, Colorado, and California. The range listed is just one component of Movement Strategy’s total compensation package for employees. Individual compensation varies based on location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards.

A successful applicant’s actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, skill sets, years of relevant experience, qualifications, and certifications or other professional licenses held. Movement Strategy prides itself on providing competitive salaries and actively works to ensure there is pay equity across the company.

Pay Range: $85,000 - $98,000 salary

Movement Strategy is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they check every single box. Movement Strategy is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourages those from historically and systemically marginalized communities to apply.

We believe that what we put out into the world matters. And since we were founded on the principles of paving our own path, we take bold steps toward what we believe is the right direction. This means addressing the big stuff: the systems of inequality that impact some of us far more than others. As culture creators, we firmly believe we have a responsibility to our colleagues, clients, communities, and the industry to live up to the Movement’s name. We confront inequities head-on as they come, knowing that this work is never done and that we must keep the momentum.

  • A consultative attitude and demonstrable experience delivering solutions to customers' requirements

  • A logical and analytical approach to problem-solving

jobs.excerpt: About NicheNiche is the leader in school search.  Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free.
jobs.description:
About Niche

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced, analytically rigorous, and collaborative Senior Marketing Analyst to own how Niche measures and improves the performance of its marketing engine, on both sides of the marketplace. This is a senior individual contributor role on the Analytics team, embedded day to day with the marketing and growth teams and reporting to the Manager of Operational Analytics.

The Senior Marketing Analyst is the analytical owner of two connected domains:

  • B2B marketing and pipeline analytics: how marketing-sourced demand becomes qualified leads, opportunities, and closed business.
  • B2C growth and registration analytics: how students and parents find Niche across acquisition channels, register, and convert into engaged users.

This is a deeply embedded role. You will sit in marketing, B2B, SEO, and lifecycle meetings and workflows, develop first-hand awareness of how data is actually being used, where the gaps are, and what's needed before it becomes a problem. You will be a strategic partner to marketing leadership rather than a reporting function: proactively surfacing insights, pairing them with recommendations and clear next steps, and staying with the work through the decision it informs.

What You Will Do

B2B Marketing & Pipeine Analytics

  • Build the measurement foundation for how Niche markets to schools and districts: define which metrics matter, how they are calculated, and where the reporting lives, so the business can see what is actually working
  • Bring rigor to questions such as which channels and campaigns produce pipeline that closes, what a marketing-sourced lead is actually worth, and where demand generation investment should go next
  • Develop leading-indicator reporting that gives marketing and sales leadership early signal on pipeline health rather than a retrospective read
  • Own the B2B attribution model in Marketo Measure, including touchpoint and channel definitions and the data flow between Marketo, Salesforce, and Snowflake. Partner with Marketing and Sales to keep campaign tracking and lead and opportunity attribution reliable over time
  • Support new business forecasting and pipeline reviews with clear, documented methodology and honest confidence levels

B2C Growth & Registration Analytics

  • Own registration and acquisition measurement end to end: registration funnel performance, campaign and channel attribution, and the connection between how a user arrived and what they went on to do on the platform
  • Measure paid acquisition efficiency: cost per registration, cost per qualified lead, and how spend translates into users who actually convert. Partner with Growth Marketing on media mix and budget decisions, and build the forecasts behind them
  • Serve as the analytical partner to Growth Marketing and Lifecycle: size opportunities, design and read out growth tests, troubleshoot tracking, and maintain the reporting the team runs on day to day
  • Build and maintain the marketing dashboards and self-serve views that let growth, lifecycle, and leadership answer their own recurring questions
  • Own organic search analytics: measure performance by page type, path, and traffic source (profiles, rankings, entity search), and quantify the impact of product decisions and algorithm updates
  • Build the monitoring and daily reporting that surfaces organic traffic shifts before they become surprises, and keep traffic definitions consistent across dashboards and the semantic layer
  • Partner with Product and Data Engineering to define the event tracking and data models this measurement depends on

Analytical Rigor & Influence

  • Model analytical rigor on marketing data: reproducible SQL, documented methodology, validated results, and a clear line between correlation and causation
  • Review and pressure-test analyses from across the analytics team and from business partners, and sharpen how findings are framed and communicated
  • Act as the subject matter expert on acquisition-funnel data sources and methodology: when analyses from Business or Product Analytics start at the top of the funnel, make sure they start from the right source, the right definition, and a method that will hold
  • Mentor analysts informally and share techniques across the analytics team
  • Partner with Data Engineering as the voice of the business: write clear measurement requirements, contribute directly to dbt models and the company-wide self-serve semantic layer, and QA what gets shipped
  • Champion AI-assisted analytics in your own work and help colleagues adopt it by building and maintaining the skills, workflows, and context that make these tools reliable on Niche's data
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership with clear insight and a clear "so what"

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, or a related field. A Master's degree is a plus
  • 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, data analytics, or a closely related data function.
  • Demonstrated experience owning marketing measurement end to end, from tracking implementation through to reporting and recommendation.
  • Hands-on experience with consumer acquisition data: web analytics and paid media platforms (GA4, Meta, Google Ads, or equivalent), including campaign and channel attribution and its limitations.
  • Direct experience with B2B marketing and pipeline analytics: lead and MQL lifecycle, multi-touch attribution, campaign and channel contribution to pipeline, and conversion through to closed business.
  • Experience working with marketing automation, CRM, and attribution data (e.g., Marketo, Marketo Measure, Salesforce) and diagnosing problems in how they connect.
  • Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insight for non-technical stakeholders, and to say plainly when the data won't support the question.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities, and resilience in the face of ambiguity and change.
  • Senior proficiency in SQL; comfortable writing, reviewing, and troubleshooting complex queries independently.
  • Strong proficiency in data visualization and dashboarding platforms such as Streamlit, Tableau, Looker, or similar.
  • Working knowledge of a modern data stack: Snowflake, dbt, and version-controlled analytics work.
  • Comfortable with experimentation and quantitative methods: designing and reading out A/B and growth tests, sizing effects honestly, and knowing when a result is signal and when it isn't.
  • A genuine practitioner of AI-assisted analytics: comfortable using tools like Claude Code in your own work, and rigorous about validating what comes back.
  • Comfort operating as a senior IC: influencing without authority, working self-directed on complex and ambiguous problems, and mentoring peers.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python or R.
  • Direct experience with SEO analytics: indexation, page-level organic performance, and technical SEO measurement.
  • Experience contributing to a semantic layer or self-serve metrics layer.
  • Background in SaaS, education technology, or marketplace analytics environments.
  • Experience in the education sector or working with schools and colleges.

Compensation

Our national target base salary range is $93,760 - $117,200, plus participation in our Annual Bonus and Stock Option Program. Base compensation will be commensurate with experience and skills.

At Niche, our Total Rewards Philosophy is centered around creating a workplace environment that attracts, motivates, and retains top talent by providing a comprehensive and competitive rewards package. This philosophy is built on the principles of performance-based compensation, best-in-class benefits and work-life balance, and employee well-being.

Interview Process

Candidate experience is a top priority for our talent and hiring teams. We believe in providing a transparent, authentic and comprehensive interview process where you have the opportunity to learn about us while we get to know you and your experience. The interview process is outlined here:

  • Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Partner - 30 Minutes

  • Hiring Manager follow-up - 30 Minutes

WhyNiche?

  • We are a fully flexible workforce empowering our employees to choose to work remotely, in our Pittsburgh office or whatever combination suits you
  • Full time, salaried position with competitive compensation in a fast-growing company
  • Best-in-class 100% paid employee health plan, including vision and dental and supplemental coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off Policy
  • Stipend that allows you to build your work from home office in a style and function that suits your personal preferences
  • Parental leave for all employees (12 weeks fully paid) in addition to short term disability for birthing parents
  • Meaningful 401(k) with employer match
  • Your ideas and work will make an immediate impact on our company and millions of users
  • You will join a team that cares about you, our mission, our work - and celebrates our wins together!

Niche will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future for this opening.
