IXOPAY is the enterprise-grade global payment infrastructure platform built for the era of agentic commerce. We equip merchants and enterprises with AI-driven intelligence, payment orchestration, advanced tokenization, and the tools to optimize every stage of the payments journey.

From intelligent routing and compliance to customizable modules and enterprise-scale orchestration, IXOPAY helps businesses integrate faster, improve payment performance, and expand globally with confidence.

At IXOPAY, our people are our greatest strength. Our collaborative culture is built on shared values that guide how we work, innovate, and support our customers.

What Makes an IXOPAYer?

We are a global team bound by one standard, where every voice matters and initiative drives real change. We thrive on progress over perfection - choosing direction over motion, working smart with modern tech and AI, and constantly learning through continuous iteration. If you are tenaciously curious, empowered to take ownership, and passionate about delivering customer-first solutions in the fast-paced world of global payments, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

IXOPAY is seeking an ambitious, high-energy Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Revenue / Sales team. In this critical role, you will be responsible for driving growth through a combination of inbound lead qualification and proactive outbound prospecting.

You are the engine of our sales pipeline. Your mission is to rapidly respond to and qualify all marketing-generated inbound leads while also strategically identifying, researching, and engaging target accounts to build pipeline through outbound outreach.

This role is perfect for someone with exceptional communication skills who thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and loves being at the critical intersection of marketing and sales.

Identify key decision-makers, timelines, and business pains to book high-quality, qualified discovery meetings for our Account Executive team.

jobs.description:
was dich erwartet

Wir leben in einer Zeit, in der Organisationen mehr denn je auf unabhängige, sichere und transparent gestaltbare IT angewiesen sind. Die Univention GmbH zählt seit über 20 Jahren zu den führenden Open-Source-Anbietern im Bereich Identity & Access Management. Mit unserem Produkt Nubus bieten wir eine modulare, skalierbare Plattform, die zentrale Benutzerverwaltung, Single Sign-On, Rechte- und Rollenmanagement sowie nahtlose Integration in heterogene IT-Umgebungen ermöglicht. Nubus ist vollständig Open Source und bietet Organisationen den entscheidenden Schlüssel für digitale Souveränität. Univention verfolgt eine klare Mission: Organisationen befähigen, die Kontrolle über ihre IT wiederzuerlangen - sicher, transparent und unabhängig.

Deine neue Rolle:
Als Head of Sales bist Du weit mehr als eine Führungskraft im klassischen Sinne - Du bist Mentor*in, Multiplikator*in und der strategische Architekt hinter unserem Vertriebserfolg.
Deine Mission ist es, unser Key Account Team nicht nur zu steuern, sondern es auf das nächste Level zu heben. Du setzt dort an, wo die einzelnen KAMs stehen, und entwickelst sie zu selbstständig agierenden, strategischen Umsatzträgern.

was du mitbringst

  • Du bist ein versierter Senior KAM: Neukundenakquisition, strategisches Account-Management, Value Selling und komplexes Entscheider-Management beherrscht Du nicht nur in der Theorie, sondern hast sie in der Praxis nachweislich erfolgreich angewendet.
  • Du liebst die Entwicklung anderer: Dich motiviert es mehr, wenn dein Team wächst und besser wird, als wenn du den Einzelabschluss feierst.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für kaufmännische Zusammenhänge, Subskriptionsmodelle und strategisches Ressourcenmanagement.
  • Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent: Du kannst komplexe Sales-Prozesse strukturieren, Feedback präzise geben und intern wie extern überzeugend auftreten.
  • Du hast Drive und Struktur: Du bringst die nötige Disziplin für ein sauberes Pipeline- und Forecast-Management mit, ohne dabei die Begeisterung für den Sales-Prozess zu verlieren.
Wofür wir Dich brauchen:
  • Du entwickelst Talente: Du analysierst die Skill-Level deiner KAMs, definierst gemeinsame Meilensteine und coachst sie direkt an realen Accounts nach dem Prinzip: Vormachen - gemeinsam machen - Verantwortung übergeben.
  • Du steuerst die Performance: Du übersetzt unsere Unternehmensziele in klare Erwartungen, sicherst einen realistischen Forecast und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team proaktiv Gegenmaßnahmen, um Pipeline-Lücken zu schließen.
  • Du etablierst Sales Excellence: Du schaffst es, individuelle Erfolge in reproduzierbare Standards zu verwandeln - von der Neukundenakquisition über Value Selling bis hin zum Closing.
  • Du bleibst nah am Markt: Durch deine eigene operative Vertriebsarbeit (ca. 20 %) bleibst Du ein Vorbild, erprobst neue Ansätze und bringst wertvolles Feedback aus dem Markt direkt in unser Produktmanagement und Leadership Team ein.
  • Du steuerst strategisch: Du identifizierst attraktive Märkte und Kundencluster und unterstützt dein Team dabei, Ressourcen dort einzusetzen, wo sie die größte Wirkung für das nachhaltige Subskriptionswachstum entfalten.
Warum diese Rolle besonders ist:
  • Du bist der Multiplikator
    Du rettest nicht einfach nur schwierige Deals – Du befähigst andere dazu, diese Herausforderungen selbst zu meistern. Das ist echte Führung.
  • Du baust ein Powerhouse auf
    Du prägst maßgeblich die vertriebliche Kultur und die Professionalität eines Teams, das die digitale Souveränität in Europa vorantreibt.
  • Du verbindest Strategie mit Praxis
    Als Player-Coach vermeidest du den „Elfenbeinturm“. Du bleibst Teil des Geschehens, während Du gleichzeitig das große Ganze steuerst.
  • Du bewegst etwas
    Indem Du unser Sales-Team stärkst, beschleunigst Du die Verbreitung unabhängiger IT-Alternativen in einem kritischen Markt.

was wir dir bieten

  • Sinnvolle Aufgabe: Du leitest den Vertrieb eines zukunftsweisenden Produkts mit hoher gesellschaftlicher Relevanz.
  • Flexibilität: Arbeite im Homeoffice oder an einem unserer Standorte – mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Privatleben vereinbaren lassen.
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit: Bei uns findest du flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Raum für deine eigenen Ideen in der Vertriebssteuerung.
  • Wertschätzung: Wir leben eine offene, respektvolle Unternehmenskultur, in der deine Expertise und deine Meinung zählen.
  • Sicherheit: Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem wachsenden Unternehmen mit einer starken Position im Markt.

jobs.description:
Product Designer (UX/UI + Design Systems | SaaS) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer (UX/UI) to own the end-to-end product experience across modern web and mobile applications.

This is a product-focused design role that goes beyond creating beautiful interfaces. You’ll combine user research, product thinking, UX strategy, UI design, and scalable design systems to build intuitive, high-performing digital products that improve usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction.

Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, you’ll transform user insights into polished, developer-ready experiences while continuously optimizing products through research, analytics, and experimentation.

If you think in user journeys, product flows, and scalable systems—not just screens—this role is for you.

Responsibilities

UX Research & Product Discovery

  • Conduct user research, interviews, usability testing, and behavioral analysis.
  • Translate research findings into personas, user journeys, workflows, and user flows.
  • Identify friction points and recommend UX improvements.
  • Leverage product analytics tools such as Mixpanel and Amplitude to inform design decisions.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to validate assumptions and prioritize user needs.

UX/UI Design

  • Design wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces.
  • Create responsive experiences across web and mobile platforms.
  • Deliver polished, user-centered designs aligned with modern SaaS design principles.
  • Produce developer-ready assets using Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch.
  • Iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback and user insights.

Design Systems & Scalability

  • Build, maintain, and evolve scalable design systems and reusable component libraries.
  • Establish standards for typography, spacing, color systems, iconography, and interaction patterns.
  • Ensure consistency across products, features, and customer touchpoints.
  • Improve collaboration between design and engineering through standardized design practices.

Accessibility & User Experience

  • Design accessible experiences that align with WCAG 2.1 standards.
  • Ensure responsive usability across devices, browsers, and screen sizes.
  • Improve navigation, information architecture, and interaction design.
  • Create intuitive experiences that reduce friction and improve engagement.

Product Optimization & Experimentation

  • Conduct A/B testing on user flows, layouts, and interaction patterns.
  • Analyze user behavior and product performance metrics.
  • Optimize conversion, engagement, onboarding, and retention through iterative improvements.
  • Continuously refine designs using analytics, usability testing, and customer feedback.

Collaboration & Developer Handoff

  • Work closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Deliver developer-ready specifications using Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or similar tools.
  • Create clear interaction documentation, design specifications, and implementation guidance.
  • Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, and product discussions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You think like a product designer—not just a visual designer.
  • You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
  • You enjoy solving complex product problems through thoughtful design.
  • You use research and data to guide design decisions.
  • You’re collaborative, organized, and comfortable working in Agile environments.
  • You care deeply about usability, accessibility, and scalable design systems.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating:
    • UX problem-solving
    • Product thinking
    • High-quality UI execution
    • Responsive product design
  • Proficiency with:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • Design systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • Accessibility standards
    • Usability testing
    • Responsive design
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing:
    • SaaS products
    • Consumer applications
    • Enterprise software
  • Experience building scalable design systems.
  • Basic front-end knowledge of:
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • JavaScript
  • Familiarity with:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Product analytics platforms

What Success Looks Like

  • Product experiences are intuitive, engaging, and user-friendly.
  • Design systems remain scalable, consistent, and widely adopted.
  • User friction decreases while engagement and retention improve.
  • Design assets are delivered on time and developer-ready.
  • Product teams collaborate efficiently with minimal implementation issues.
  • User feedback and analytics consistently inform design improvements.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Portfolio Review & Practical Design Task
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about designing intuitive product experiences, enjoy solving user problems through research and thoughtful design, and want to help build scalable SaaS products, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape digital experiences that users love.

Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your Mission

As part of the Engine team, you'll play a vital role in an environment where innovation meets collaboration. Engine X is a startup inside a platform, and the motion is still being built. Here's what you'll take charge of:

  • Drive Card Adoption Across Your Territory: Own a defined book of business, converting existing Engine customers and net-new logos into active Engine X cardholders who spend. You carry a number and are accountable to it.
  • Lead and Develop a Team of AEs: Manage a team of Account Executives focused on Engine X. Run pipeline reviews, coach to the motion, identify performance gaps, and hold a high bar for execution.
  • Sell as a Genuine Player-Coach: Stay close enough to deals to model the pitch, handle objections, and close alongside your reps. In the early stages of the build, your personal execution sets the standard for the team.
  • Build Pipeline and Represent the Field: Develop and maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline across inbound and outbound channels with forecasting rigor, and surface patterns from the field (common objections, product gaps, buyer signals) back to the Sr. Sales Director and product teams to sharpen the motion.

What You'll Bring to Engine

We're looking for someone who's ready to make an impact and grow alongside us:

  • Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience selling corporate card or spend management products to SMB or mid-market buyers, including 1+ year leading a team of Account Executives. Generalist fintech experience without direct card sales is not a substitute.
  • Skills: You're a frontline sales leader who coaches to a high standard, runs disciplined pipeline reviews, and moves fast on underperformance, and you thrive in fast-paced environments where the playbook is still being written.
  • Tech-Savvy: Fluent in the corporate card sale: card economics, activation rates, interchange, spend velocity, and the CFO buyer's calculus. Bonus points for strong SFDC hygiene and comfort building forecasting rhythm from scratch.
  • Mindset: You're a genuine player-coach who leads from inside the deals rather than from a distance, and you're data-driven enough to know which metrics matter, how to read a pipeline for real signal, and when to trust your gut versus when to go back to the numbers.

Applications for this role will be accepted through December 22, 2026 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$120,000—$144,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

jobs.description:
Contract Psychologist 1099 / Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) – ABA Centers

1099 Independent Contractor | Remote

When providing services as a BCBA: $70–$110 per hour (based on experience and qualifications)

When providing services as a Licensed Psychologist: $80–$150 per hour (based on experience and qualifications)

Who We Are

We are the nation’s fastest-growing provider of autism care, delivering high-quality Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy across a rapidly expanding footprint. Since our founding in 2020, we’ve scaled from a single clinic to nearly 70 operating areas in more than a dozen states, supported by a high-performance corporate infrastructure and data-driven decision-making.

 

Recognized as the #5 fastest-growing private company in America by Inc. magazine, ABA Centers is a self-funded, founder-led organization—a rarity in today’s healthcare landscape. We’ve achieved this growth without private equity, relying instead on operational discipline, smart capital allocation, and a relentless focus on outcomes.

 

Our Origin Story

ABA Centers was founded by a father whose personal journey navigating autism care for his daughter revealed deep gaps in access, consistency, and quality across the system. Determined to disrupt the status quo in the autism care field and eliminate the unacceptably long wait lists for treatment, he built a company rooted in compassion, clinical excellence, and a relentless commitment to care that makes a difference.

 

Recognition & Awards

Our commitment to operational excellence, ethical leadership, and transformative care has earned our company and leadership national recognition from trusted sources, including:

  • Inc. 5000 – 5th Fastest-Growing Private Company in America
  • Financial Times – #1 on "The Americas' Fastest Growing Companies" 
  • EY Entrepreneur Of The Year® U.S. Overall
  • South Florida Business Journal’s Top 100 Companies
  • Florida Trend Magazine's 500 Most Influential Business Leaders
  • Inc. Best in Business, Health Services 

POSITION SUMMARY & PURPOSE

ABA Centers of America provides year-round therapeutic intervention for children, adolescents, and adults with autism spectrum disorder using the science of applied behavior analysis (ABA). Services are delivered in clinic, home, and community settings.

This dual-role 1099 contractor position combines the clinical responsibilities of a Licensed Psychologist (under the Director of the Diagnostic Services Department) with those of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst. The contractor will complete psychological/neuropsychological evaluations, review and sign reports, supervise and train diagnostic staff, and also maintain a caseload of 6–9 learners receiving insurance-funded or private-pay ABA services. The principal functions identified shall not be considered a complete description of all work requirements. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

POSITION ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

As Psychologist / Diagnostic Services

  • Provide comprehensive neuropsychological, psychological, and/or psychoeducational evaluations of clients with referral concerns related to learning, behavioral, emotional, and/or social difficulties.
  • Conduct in-person and/or virtual evaluations.
  • Provide written and oral feedback to clients (or legal guardians) regarding results, diagnostic impressions, and recommendations.
  • Compile written reports detailing evaluation findings, diagnosis(es), and recommendations for the medical record and sharing with patients/guardians and referral sources (in accordance with HIPAA).
  • Ensure timely documentation upload per departmental policy.
  • Provide direct supervision (individual/group) and training of Neuropsychological Testing/Assessment to Diagnostic Specialists (Psychometrists/Technicians).
  • Participate in weekly Regional Clinical Training Meetings and present at Weekly Psychology Assessment Didactic Seminars (PADS).
  • Remain current in the field and pursue continuing education related to pediatric psychological/neuropsychological testing.
  • Maintain an active license and good standing with the state board of psychology.
  • Comply with ABA Centers of America’s HIPAA privacy and security policies.

As Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA)

  • Design, implement, and monitor skill-acquisition and behavior-reduction programs.
  • Research literature related to specific learners’ programs.
  • Oversee the implementation of behavior-analytic programs by RBTs and caregivers.
  • Conduct assessments related to the need for behavioral intervention (e.g., preference assessments, functional assessments,
  • staff performance assessments).
  • Analyze and summarize assessment results and graph data as needed.
  • Write 6-month progress reports to secure insurance funding.
  • Provide staff and caregiver training.
  • Facilitate team meetings for each learner every other week.
  • Create goals for skill generalization and update program sheets as skills meet criteria.
  • Create or update data collection systems.
  • Be available to answer questions from technicians and caregivers; follow up to ensure generalization of objectives.
  • Complete and submit documentation in a timely manner to the billing agency.
  • Oversee the restricted hours of 1–2 Apprentices.
  • Oversee a maximum of 3 trainees seeking supervision toward Supervised Fieldwork experience (weekly 1-hour meetings,
  • documentation review, and competency development using BTS in program writing, training, assessments, parent training,
  • treatment plans, and other analytical tasks).
  • Delegate case management tasks to competent trainees and provide feedback.
  • Be willing and able to supervise others seeking BCBA certification weekly.
  • Shared / Collaborative Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with families, schools, and ASD service providers in the child’s community.
  • Collaborate with all team members to facilitate the mission of ABA Centers of America, including attending routine
  • departmental and general staff meetings.
  • Actively seek supervision when needed.

Requirements

Education and Experience Requirements

Psychologist track: Doctoral Degree in Clinical Psychology or Developmental Psychology (Psy.D. or Ph.D.) with specific training in assessment of pediatric and adolescent neurodevelopmental disorders, including specific learning disorders, ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, and intellectual disability. Prior training and experience with administration, scoring, and interpretation of neuropsychological tests required. Experience administering measures of Intellectual Functioning, Development, Autism Spectrum Disorder (including the ADOS-2), Social Communication, and Emotional and Behavioral Functioning.

BCBA track: Minimum of a Master’s Degree in Applied Behavior Analysis (required) and current BCBA certification/licensure.

Two years’ experience in the ABA field preferred. Excellent report-writing skills.

  • Ability to effectively collaborate with families, schools, and ASD service providers.
  • Effective organizational, time-management, prioritization, communication, interpersonal, and team skills.
  • Ability to pass background and drug screens.
  • Willingness to sign company NDA and any revisions thereafter.
  • Maintain clean background/drug screenings and driving record (required).
  • English proficiency required; Spanish proficiency is a plus.

Technology / Equipment Used

  • Computer/Laptop
  • Fax/Copy/Scanner Machine
  • Telephone System
  • Calculator

Work Environment / Physical & Mental Demands

Most work (approximately 95%) is performed indoors in a temperature-controlled environment. Potential exposures to workplace violence and hazards are low. Physical and mental demands are consistent with the requirements of providing clinical evaluations and ABA services in clinic, home, and community settings (standing, walking, bending, crouching, carrying, sitting, reading, light lifting, moderate mental stress, and high collaboration with others).

Benefits

Compensation and Contractor Status

  • 1099 Independent Contractor role.
  • Rates as listed above based on the type of service provided and the contractor’s experience/qualifications.
  • Contractors are responsible for their own taxes, licensure, and professional liability coverage.
  • No employee benefits are provided.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Us Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish.
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish. We began as a digital mortgage broker and became Canada's leading direct-to-consumer online lending platform. Through Nesto Cloud, our B2B, cloud-native, end-to-end mortgage technology platform, we empower financial institutions, credit unions, and commercial real estate lenders with intelligent automation, real-time compliance, and seamless integrations across the full lending lifecycle. Together with CMLS Financial, we form the Nesto Group: more than $73 billion CAD in residential and commercial mortgages under management, 1,300+ team members, 12 offices across Canada.

Why We Are Hiring

As we partner with more financial institutions to modernize their mortgage operations through Nesto Cloud, we are adding two new Project Manager roles, growing our team from four to six. As Canada's most advanced cloud-based mortgage technology, our SaaS solution offers a best-in-class omnichannel experience. This platform consistently drives volume, boosts productivity, and lowers technology costs.

Work Location and Language Requirements

We are looking for someone in Ontario, with a preference for candidates based in the GTA.

What Success Looks Like

As a Project Manager on nesto's B2B delivery team, you'll lead large, multi-stream SaaS implementation programs for our financial-institution partners. This role combines discovery and implementation ownership, from early requirements through delivery, testing, and post-launch stabilization. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, operations, and leadership to ensure programs are delivered efficiently and all stakeholders remain aligned. In order to be successful:

  • You take immediate ownership and drive progress from day one, even when faced with ambiguity.
  • You proactively organize work and bring structure where processes don't exist.
  • You will identify and help implement foundational product management standards and practices – as the team was established recently, we are still building the infrastructure required for a highly efficient PM organization.
  • You ramp up quickly on our SaaS delivery model – enterprise SaaS delivery experience is a must.
  • You demonstrate strong learning agility by absorbing large amounts of new information quickly.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of enterprise client implementations, from discovery through deployment and post-launch transition.
  • Facilitate discovery workshops along side our SMEs and requirements sessions to define scope, dependencies, and timelines.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into actionable delivery plans using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Product, Engineering, QA, Operations) and external vendors to drive progress and resolve blockers.
  • Manage project budgets, schedules, and dependencies across multiple workstreams.
  • Provide clear, consistent communication to client and internal stakeholders, including weekly status reports, risk logs, and steering committee updates.
  • Track project health and proactively identify delivery risks, capacity constraints, and cross-program dependencies.
  • Partner with other PMs to align workstreams across major accounts
  • Contribute to the evolution of nesto’s delivery framework.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in project management, with at least 3 years in SaaS environments.
  • Experience or understanding of non-functional requirements (e.g. monitoring, alerting, high availability, production / cloud operations), relevant to SaaS platforms.
  • Direct customer interaction experience, as you'll be responsible for driving customer meetings.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, confident interfacing with executives, clients, and technical teams.
  • Comfortable managing complex, ambiguous programs with many moving parts, and able to bring structure, communication, and predictability to cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced organizational skills and the ability to drive coordination across diverse teams.
  • Proficiency in project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar.
  • Knowledge of Agile or hybrid delivery models, with the ability to adapt process to context.

Nice-to-Have

  • Project management credentials & methods: PMP (Project Management Professional) and Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) and/or other agile PM certifications.
  • A technical background, ideally in engineering or a similar adjacent domain.
  • Experience working with financial institutions, mortgage or lending technology, or regulated B2B environments.
  • Experience using AI tools (Claude, Gemini, etc.) to improve or streamline your work and workflows.

This Role Might Be for You If

  • You thrive in ambiguous environments and can drive clarity without a playbook.
  • You enjoy building structure from scratch and take pride in leaving things more organized than you found them.
  • You lead with a servant-leader mindset – you enable your team rather than manage from above.
  • You're motivated by rapid learning and get energized when there's a lot to absorb quickly.
  • You welcome high leadership exposure and are comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders.
  • You're adaptable and can shift priorities without losing momentum.

You Shouldn’t Apply If

  • You don't have proven experience in a SaaS environment, or lack an understanding of operations topics like monitoring, alerting, high availability, and production/cloud operations.
  • Your experience is strictly internal. If you've only managed back-office projects or internal tool rollouts, you'll lack the client-facing experience this role requires.
  • You need a predefined playbook to succeed. We're building our processes while delivering a massive initiative, so if you need established structures and "perfect" documentation to get started, you'll find our environment frustrating.
  • You're coming from a large, rigid corporate environment and are looking for a slow pace or clear departmental boundaries. Our PM scope will likely feel overwhelming.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): An intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call (30 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
  • Take-Home Assignment / Case Study: A chance to showcase your skills through a practical exercise relevant to the role.
  • Case Study Interview (45 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
  • Final Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and two additional stakeholders for a final conversation before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background, criminal, and reference checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Top-tier extended health, dental, and vision coverage, featuring 100% drug coverage.
  • Health & Wellness Spending Account: A $1,500 combined annual flex fund for things like gym memberships or extra medical needs.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation plus 8 personal floater days.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a group RRSP/DPSP plan featuring competitive company-matching contributions.
  • Telemedicine Services: Access via Dialogue and coverage for licensed practitioner services.
  • Family Support: Robust Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up programs.

Why Join Us

The mortgage industry runs on legacy systems, slow processes, and information nobody can see. We are changing that by building better technology. nesto is a place for builders, problem-solvers, and curious minds – people who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we're stronger together. This is the place for you if you trust your skills and want to build technology that reshapes an entire industry. An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients. We also do not think building with AI belongs to engineers. Every function here is expected to automate its own repetitive work, and you will have support to do it.

Our Track Record

  • Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 – 3 years in a row
  • Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025
  • Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year – 4 consecutive years
  • Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025

Diversity and Inclusion

At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. We are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

Description

Keeper Security is hiring an experienced Sales Engineer to join our B2B sales team. This is a 100% remote position with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for navigating our customers through the technical landscape of our products.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is transforming cybersecurity for people and organizations around the world. Keeper’s affordable and easy-to-use solutions are built on a foundation of zero-trust and zero-knowledge security to protect every user on every device. Our award-winning, zero-trust, privileged access management platform deploys in minutes and seamlessly integrates with any tech stack and identity application to provide visibility, security, control, reporting and compliance across an entire enterprise. Trusted by millions of individuals and thousands of organizations, Keeper is an innovator of best-in-class password management, secrets management, privileged access, secure remote access and encrypted messaging. Learn more at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Role

As an Enterprise Sales Engineer you will work alongside the Keeper Security sales force by supporting the pre-sales and post-sales cycle from a technical perspective. You will be responsible for identifying the technical requirements within an opportunity, matching them to Keeper Security solutions, and supporting the sale by positioning and demonstrating differences. You will provide product trials and evaluations to Keeper Security partners, assist with implementation and integration, and provide level-2 technical assistance to existing customers.

Responsibilities

  • Provide and manage pre-sales technical support for the technical sales process of Keeper products
  • Work closely with the sales team to identify customer opportunities and understand their business needs
  • Conduct product demonstrations and technical presentations remotely, at customer locations, or on-site at a Keeper facility
  • Collaborate with product development and engineering teams to stay updated on product features, enhancements, and updates
  • Address technical questions, concerns, and objections during the sales process to ensure customer confidence and satisfaction
  • Act as a technical advisor to customers, helping them understand how our solutions can solve their business challenges and achieve their goals
  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies relevant to the business
  • Analyze complex multivariate problems and use a systematic approach to gain quick resolution, often under pressure
  • Works on issues that affect design/selling success or address future concepts, products or technologies
  • Establish relationships and engage with the technical personnel to identify opportunities and sell Keeper Security products and services
  • Ensure accurate and timely activity, issue updates in Salesforce and report to management
  • Create and deliver technical product presentations and/or training sessions to channel partners and customers

  • Contribute to the execution of company objectives to achieve goals in creative and effective ways

Requirements

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and a strong entrepreneurial drive
  • Strong experience with Windows/Active Directory administration and knowledge of UNIX/Linux
  • Outstanding presentation skills and the ability to build and demonstrate a high quality product overview to both technical and executive level audiences
  • Technical background in networking and security applications as well as cloud technologies (AWS, Azure)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent work experience
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%

Preferred Requirements

  • Industry recognized certifications
  • Scripting and DevOps experience a plus
  • Exposure to Identity Providers like Azure and Okta
  • Experience providing solutions to and understanding the requirements of Enterprise Customers
  • Prior experience with cybersecurity solutions or relevant experience with IAM or other security SAAS solutions

Benefits

  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401k (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

About the Product Team

You’ll join a lean, world-class Product Team. We’ve thought deeply about what winning product culture looks like in competitive markets being reshaped by AI. The team prizes founder-level commercial instinct, the bandwidth to cover broad areas, and extremely fast iteration aided by product-minded engineers and AI. We’re the team that invented Reverse ETL, pioneered the Composable architecture, landed AI Decisioning as a category, and most recently invented Agentic Marketing.

Why this role matters

This portfolio is the majority of Hightouch's revenue — and it deserves a single, dedicated owner. Audiences, traits, experiments, analytics, and orchestration are the surfaces our customers live in every day, but the unifying vision across them has so far been carried by founders and shared across the team. We're hiring this role to change that: one person accountable for the health, direction, and growth of our core.

What you’ll own

We're looking for a product leader for the core surface area of Hightouch: the interfaces marketers live in every day and the largest driver of our revenue. You'll own a broad portfolio spanning:

  • Audiences — the segmentation and targeting experience at the center of Hightouch
  • Charts & Dashboards — analytics surfaces for customers to uncover audience insights and monitor performance
  • Experiments — automation and measurement tools to run & monitor cross-channel experiments
  • Trait Building — no-code interfaces to build custom business logic and data attributes to power marketing campaigns
  • Orchestration — primitives for how campaigns and journeys are sequenced and coordinated globally across all of Hightouch

We need someone who can drive clarity, set prioritization, and bring a unifying vision across that entire portfolio.

What you’ll do

The role’s mandate spans multiple modes of product work: from 0-1 innovation to deepening established surfaces to scaling emerging areas. A significant part of the job will be deciding what to prioritize and what outcomes to achieve in which order to hit our company revenue goals. Some examples include:

  • Building 0→1 in global orchestration: defining the right audience, campaign and journey primitives for AI-native, Fortune 100-class marketing programs
  • Expanding audience targeting & syncing to better support advanced use cases like couponing and live auctions
  • Transforming our investment in charts, dashboards, and experimentation to better interface with Hightouch Agentic Marketing

This is a senior, hands-on role — think “product GM.” You'll be fully accountable for both product adoption and go-to-market success, leading across multiple Engineering and Design workstreams. You'll present frequently to customers, work directly with executives, and shape company strategy.

About You

  • Customer Obsession: You are a relentless customer champion. Your superpower is the ability to forge deep connections, intuitively anticipating needs before customers can even articulate them.
  • Technical Aptitude: More than just understanding technical concepts, you're a translator who turns complex engineering challenges into elegant, accessible solutions. You speak both engineer and business fluently.
  • Strong Communicator: You can drive clarity and distill complex ideas into compelling narratives that inspire teams and resonate with users, turning insights into action.
  • Hunger and Speed: Speed isn't just a preference for you—it's a way of life. You thrive in a high-energy environment where rapid iteration and bold moves are the default, not the exception.
  • Outcome Mindset: You're not a feature factory—you're a strategic mastermind who reverse-engineers success. Every decision you make is laser-focused on driving measurable business impact, turning product vision into tangible results.

Interview Process

  • Hiring Manager Interview [30m]: Chat with Hiring Manager about past experiences and interests to assess role and company fit.
  • Technical & UX Interview [90m]: Live conversation with a Product Manager covering the technical architecture and user experience of a potential feature inside Hightouch.
  • Case Study Interview: Part 1 [45m]: Presentation of the take-home case study (1st part), focusing on problem space discovery and GTM validation.
  • Case Study Interview: Part 2 [45m]: Presentation of the take-home case study (2nd part), focusing on solution mapping and MVP scope.

We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals who are interested in tackling the problems above. This is a senior role, but we focus on impact and potential for growth more than years of experience. The salary range for this position is $240,000 - $320,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation in the form of ISO options, and offer early exercise and a 10 year post-termination exercise window.

E-Verify Statement

Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

Clinical Associate

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

Our Abbott story is one of delivering bold solutions in the face of complex healthcare challenges. At Abbott Electrophysiology (EP), we’ve been a leader for over 20 years, pioneering one of the first mapping systems, introducing the first contact force ablation catheter and creating a portfolio of products trusted in millions of procedures around the world. We have and will continue to redefine what’s possible in an evolving and challenging EP landscape.

When you join Abbott EP, you become part of a passionate group of individuals who are dedicated to driving the EP space forward and helping people live longer, fuller lives. We are committed to building a foundation for our people to be successful, investing in their development and growth, and creating a diverse, inclusive culture that welcomes different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds.

What You’ll Work On

Working under general direction, provides engineering, sales, educational and technical support in response to field inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients, and field sales staff, involving EP products. Performs work that involves a high degree of independence. Identifies and routinely uses the most effective, cost efficient and best business practices to execute processes; continually evaluates their effectiveness and appropriateness. Exercises independent judgment in planning, organizing and performing work; monitors performance and reports status to manager.

As a Clinical Associate on the U.S. Abbott EP team, you will provide clinical and technical support in a hospital setting, utilizing EP technology in the treatment of various cardiac arrhythmias. You will join a high-functioning, collaborative team, partnering closely with physicians and hospital staff to support the diagnosis and treatment of abnormal heart rhythms to achieve better patient outcomes. In this role, individuals will exercise independent judgment in planning, organizing, and performing day-to-day tasks. You will identify and routinely use the most effective, cost-efficient, and best business practices to execute processes, regularly communicating insights, feedback, and results to managers and team. Additional responsibilities include:

  • Gaining foundational knowledge of EP through a structured training program with a strong emphasis on hands-on learning and practical application.

  • Providing regional EP procedural case coverage in an Electrophysiology lab and/or operating room setting.

  • Acting as a clinical interface between the medical community and the business.

  • Demonstrating the ability to build and sustain credible clinical relationships with customers and sharing product expertise accordingly.

  • Demonstrating a thorough command of all EP products, including technical details, software utilization, and capabilities.

  • Providing engineering, sales, education, and clinical support on the safe and effective use of Abbott EP products, including cardiac mapping, diagnostic, and therapy systems.

  • Supporting EP Sales Representatives in the following areas:

    • Collaborating with sales personnel;

    • Facilitating regional training seminars;

    • Participating in clinical studies/data collection;

    • Troubleshooting; and,

    • Leading/supporting new product in-service trainings and/or demonstrations to physicians, nurses, and sales representatives.

Company Overview

Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

About the Role

Reporting to the Associate Director, Demand Generation, this role carries a two-part mandate: deep expertise in SEO, AEO, AIO, and GEO — how Agility gets found by search engines and by the AI answer engines increasingly replacing them — and ownership of all of Agility's organic social media.

The strategic mission is direct. Today, roughly 80% of our marketing-qualified leads come from paid channels. Your job is to change that mix: grow organic's share of MQLs quarter over quarter, and prove that organic leads convert to opportunities and closed-won business at a higher rate than paid. Your scoreboard depends on the attribution model our Rev/Marketing Operations Manager is building; you two will be close partners.

On the search and AI-visibility side, you own how Agility appears in LLM-generated answers: a recurring measurement battery of the questions our buyers actually ask AI assistants, the technical and content work that moves those results, and the AEO discipline applied to everything we publish. You are thinking, always, about how we market to the LLMs.

On the social side, you own every organic channel: follower growth, engagement, and a social content calendar wired directly to our demand generation campaigns and our flagship research reports. Paid social sits with our paid media specialist so you can focus entirely on organic growth from any and every channel. You will also evaluate whether Bulldog Reporter warrants its own social presence — and if it does, you will run both programs.

You also own a distinctive conversion loop: our conversational AI pilot surfaces the content and knowledge gaps visitors actually hit. You read those gaps, define the missing content, partner with the Product & Customer Marketing Manager or the Director of Communications & Content to produce it, and own the resulting lift in time on site, form fills, and MQLs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Organic's share of MQLs grows quarter over quarter against a paid-dominated baseline.
  • Once attribution is live, organic MQLs demonstrably convert to opportunities and closed-won at a higher rate than paid.
  • Agility's visibility in LLM-generated answers improves measurably on the recurring quarterly query battery.
  • Organic social followers and engagement grow across channels, with a calendar that visibly serves campaigns and flagship research.
  • The content-gap loop runs: gaps identified, content produced with partners, and lift in site engagement and form fills attributed to it.
  • The Bulldog Reporter social channel decision is made with evidence, and executed.

What You'll Do

Search & Answer-Engine Optimization

  • Own technical SEO and AEO across the site: architecture, structured data, and content optimization for both search engines and AI answer engines.
  • Set keyword and topic strategy in service of campaign and product priorities.
  • Apply an AEO lens to everything the content organization publishes.

AI & LLM Visibility (GEO)

  • Run the recurring quarterly measurement battery of buyer questions across major AI assistants; report movement and diagnose causes.
  • Execute the technical and content plays that improve how Agility is represented in AI-generated answers.
  • Stay current on the fast-moving GEO discipline and bring what works back into our program.

Organic Social

  • Own all organic social channels: monitoring, strategy, calendar, posting, community engagement, and analytics.
  • Wire the social calendar to demand generation campaigns and flagship research launches.
  • Grow followers and engagement with a daily and weekly numbers habit.
  • Evaluate, recommend, and if warranted run a separate Bulldog Reporter social program.

Content-Gap & Conversion Loop

  • Read the content and knowledge gaps surfaced by our conversational AI pilot.
  • Define the missing content and partner with product marketing or the content organization to produce it.
  • Own the resulting lift: time on site, form fills, and MQLs from organic.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven SEO and AEO expertise, including hands-on GEO work: you have measured and moved how a brand appears in LLM-generated answers, and you can show it.
  • Strong technical SEO: site architecture, structured data, and performance fundamentals.
  • B2B organic social experience, especially LinkedIn, with growth and engagement numbers you can speak to.
  • Analytics fluency across web and social; comfort building your own reporting.
  • A daily and weekly numbers habit and a relentless test-learn-iterate loop: you find what resonates and compound on it.
  • The mindset this era requires: you think about how we market to the LLMs, not only to people and search engines.
  • Collaborative instincts — your biggest wins will be produced with partners in content, product marketing, and operations.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Health, Dental & Vision benefits

About Cedar Gate Technologies

Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, enables payers, providers, employers, and service administrators to excel at value-based care with a unified technology and services platform delivering analytics, care, and payment technology on a single data management foundation. At Cedar Gate, you’ll be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where great ideas thrive. We invest deeply in our people through ongoing training, comprehensive benefits, and a strong culture of teamwork, offering the chance to grow your skills while contributing to high impact initiatives for some of the world's most dynamic companies.

Position Summary

The Healthcare Analytics, AI Product & Methodology Analyst at Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, will help evaluate how AI can be effectively applied to healthcare analytics and provider performance insights. This role focuses on identifying opportunities to leverage generative AI and other emerging technologies to improve how healthcare data is analyzed, interpreted, and delivered to end users.

The ideal candidate has a foundation in healthcare analytics, data analysis, or a related field and is eager to explore the practical application of AI within healthcare. Working closely with product, analytics, methodology, and AI/ML engineering teams, this individual will help define requirements, assess analytical outputs, and contribute to the development of AI-enabled products. This role is well suited for a developing analyst who enjoys solving complex problems, learning new technologies, and bridging business, data, and product perspectives to create meaningful solutions.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Support the development and evaluation of AI-enabled healthcare analytics solutions, helping define business and analytical requirements for tools that deliver provider cost, utilization, and quality insights.
  • Collaborate with product, analytics, and AI/ML teams to translate user needs, reporting requirements, and business objectives into effective analytics and AI-driven capabilities.
  • Review and assess AI-generated outputs to ensure alignment with healthcare reporting methodologies, measure definitions, and user expectations.
  • Participate in testing and validation activities, including identifying discrepancies, documenting issues, and helping determine whether solutions meet business and analytical requirements.
  • Analyze the impact of changes to clinical groupers, attribution methodologies, and reporting approaches on provider performance measurement and healthcare analytics outputs.
  • Compare current and proposed methodologies, identify meaningful differences in results, and help evaluate potential impacts on trends, benchmarks, and stakeholder interpretation.
  • Provide analytical and healthcare domain feedback on AI models, predictive outputs, and emerging product features to support solution quality, usability, and business relevance.
  • Identify data quality concerns, unexpected results, and opportunities for improvement, escalating complex methodological or interpretation issues when appropriate.
  • Prepare clear documentation, analyses, and summaries that communicate findings, assumptions, recommendations, and testing results to cross-functional stakeholders.

United States – Remote

U.S. residents only; work must be performed within the United States.

Experience / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Health Informatics, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • At least 1 year of experience in healthcare analytics, medical economics, provider or payer analytics, health services research, or a related analytical discipline; 3+ years is preferred.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data and performance measurement concepts, including medical and pharmacy claims, provider reporting, quality measures, and cost or utilization analytics.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate data, identify trends, ask thoughtful questions, and draw meaningful conclusions.
  • Demonstrated intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and interest in exploring new technologies and approaches to solving business problems.
  • Ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for business partners and stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including analytics, product management, data science, and technology partners.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Excel; experience with Python, R, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools is preferred.

  • Experience working in a payer, provider, healthcare technology, or healthcare consulting environment is preferred.
  • Exposure to predictive analytics, AI/ML solutions, generative AI tools, or data-driven product development is preferred.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Social Media Senior Manager to our Marketing team in US!

The US is one of Wellhub's largest, most dynamic, and most socially engaged markets—and we're looking for a Senior Manager of Social Media who will own the shaping and execution of our social media strategy locally. In this role, you'll partner closely with our Senior Director of Global Social Media to bring the US strategy to life—creating platform-specific content, developing cultural relevance, supporting local influencer and ambassador programs, and elevating Wellhub's presence across key platforms like Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging channels. You're someone who lives and breathes social. You understand US culture deeply. You know how to move fast, test fearlessly, and capture moments in real time. You have a video-first mindset and love being behind—and occasionally in front of—the camera. This is a high-visibility role where your creativity, agility, and understanding of US social trends will directly influence how millions of consumers, partners, and companies experience Wellhub.

  • Localize and operationalize Wellhub's US social media strategy, building regionally relevant content plans for B2C, B2B, and B2P audiences.

  • Oversee proactive community management across US channels—engaging in conversations, responding to comments, and cultivating brand advocates—while ensuring alignment with global crisis and response protocols.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

jobs.excerpt: Sobre Nosotros:En Koltin, estamos rediseñando la forma en que cuidamos a nuestros papás, mamás, abuelos y abuelas, con el objetivo de ayudarles a mantenerse saludables, activos e independientes durante el mayor tiempo posible.
jobs.description:
Sobre Nosotros:

En Koltin, estamos rediseñando la forma en que cuidamos a nuestros papás, mamás, abuelos y abuelas, con el objetivo de ayudarles a mantenerse saludables, activos e independientes durante el mayor tiempo posible. Lo hacemos a través de nuestras membresías de salud, que integran:

  • Atención clínica enfocada en la prevención
  • Cobertura médica de gastos mayores
  • Programas de bienestar y comunidad

Somos la primera empresa en México que protege a personas adultas mayores, desde los 50 hasta los 84 años. Estamos creciendo rápidamente en todo el país, con un propósito claro: transformar la experiencia de salud para las Grandes Personas, haciéndola más humana, accesible y digna.

Sobre el puesto

  • Como Médico Geriatra, estarás a cargo de gestionar de manera presencial los casos clínicos de nuestros clientes (pacientes) y garantizar que cada una de las grandes personas logre sus objetivos de salud; envejecimiento activo y saludable. Serás pieza clave para continuar atendiendo de manera preventiva a los pacientes y mantengamos un índice de siniestralidad sano.
  • Como Médico Geriatra participarás en el equipo de salud, quienes llevan toda la operación para que nuestras membresías sean la mejor experiencia a nuestros usuario. Este rol reporta directamente a nuestra Coordinadora Médica.

Eres un buen fit si eres una persona que:

  • Graduada de Medicina con Especialidad en Geriatría. (Cuente con título y cédula indispensable).
  • Preferentemente con Certificación Geriátrica vigente.
  • Confía en que la tecnología puede ayudar a lograr un envejecimiento saludable.
  • Sea empática, tenga muy buena comunicación oral y escrita.
  • Es proactiva y con mucha energía.
  • Es capaz de transmitir confianza y calidez.
  • Le gusta trabajar en equipo para lograr un objetivo en conjunto.
  • Comparte aprendizajes para el crecimiento del equipo y de la empresa.
  • Tenga experiencia de al menos 1 año en atención clínica a personas mayores.
  • Cuente con experiencia (media-alta) en telemedicina.
  • Tenga facilidad con la tecnología y nuevas herramientas.
  • Gestione su tiempo de manera óptima.
  • Tenga habilidades de identificación y resolución de problemas.
  • Sea generadora de ideas en pro de la salud integral de nuestros clientes-pacientes y para el crecimiento de Koltin.

Responsabilidades:

  • Promover el envejecimiento saludable mediante la detección, abordaje y prevención de riesgo de accidentes, así cómo incidir en la condición del proceso salud-enfermedad de cada paciente a través de una intervención integral puntual y personalizada, presencial.
  • Realizarás valoraciones médicas integrales en nuestro modelo de atención modular denominado Estudio de Longevidad, tu intervención consistirá en realizar historias clínicas para apertura de expediente médico, exploración física completa, glucometría capilar, electrocardiograma y espirometría.
  • Crearás informes de salud concluyendo los resultados e interpretación de la secuencia de valoración presencial en nuestros consultorios.
  • Valoración funcional, cognitiva y anímica
  • Valoración biológica (salud física)
  • Riesgo futuro
  • Tendrás disponible un expediente médico electrónico de cada cliente para consultar la información previa y los resultados de otras áreas.
  • Contarás con una red de especialistas en el área médica (eg. nutrición, gerontología, ortopedia, reumatología, urología, cardiología, etc.) a quienes puedes recurrir para canalizar a los pacientes.
  • Apoyar en el diseño y elaboración de contenido (escrito, visual, audiovisual que promuevan el envejecimiento saludable en nuestros diferentes medios de comunicación KOLTIN y eventos relevantes del ecosistema.

Objetivos del rol:

  • Fomentar la autonomía del paciente/recuperación de su funcionalidad para mantener su independencia.
  • Seguimiento de comorbilidades para mantenerlas en control.
  • Diagnóstico oportuno de comorbilidades.
  • Seguimiento y manejo de síndromes geriátricos.
  • Educación para el paciente y familiares (ej: disminución de riesgo de caídas).
  • Seguimiento de siniestros, ej: pacientes hospitalizados, los contactaríamos al estar en casa.
  • Colaborar en la capacitación de miembros del equipo directo, ejemplo: con el área de servicio al cliente, otras áreas del equipo de salud.

Beneficios:

🎓 Acceso a herramientas y beneficios para tu crecimiento profesional, como cursos, talleres, libros, etc
💊 Asistencia médica privada por videollamada (médico general, nutriólogo y psicólogo) ilimitado para ti y 3 familiares
🏈 Acceso a herramientas para tu cuidado físico (TotalPass)
🌴 9 días adicionales de personal leave por ley al año

👓 Seguro de Gastos Médicos Mayores

💻 Equipo necesario para hacer tu trabajo

💵 Apoyo mensual de $500 pesos adicionales al sueldo mensual
💎 Apoyo de 2,000 por ocasión única tras periodo de prueba

We are seeking a highly skilled, technical Survey Programming Consultant to join our growing Global Programming & Hosting (P&H) team. In this hands-on role, you will be responsible for translating our clients' complex research requirements into highly functional, error-free online surveys.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)
