jobs.title: Vice President, Communications
jobs.excerpt: THE ORGANIZATIONThe Charter School Growth Fund (CSGF) is a leading nonprofit venture philanthropy fund dedicated to identifying the nation’s best public charter schools, investing in their expansion, and helping to increase their impact.
jobs.description:
THE ORGANIZATION

The Charter School Growth Fund (CSGF) is a leading nonprofit venture philanthropy fund dedicated to identifying the nation’s best public charter schools, investing in their expansion, and helping to increase their impact. Our “portfolio” includes 200+ charter school networks that operate 1,700+ schools and serve more than 725,000 students. We are committed to expanding the impact of schools that are closing achievement and opportunity gaps. CSGF operates with the same strategies, discipline, and focus as a venture capital firm by awarding multi-year grants and loans to talented education entrepreneurs building networks of high-quality charter schools that enroll traditionally underserved students. Our goal is to serve 1,000,000 students by 2030 and 1.4 million by 2035.

This is an exciting time to join the Charter School Growth Fund. We are launching Fund V, our most ambitious fund yet, building on our 20-year track record of success. Fund V will add 250,000 new high-quality seats while helping our portfolio become durable, bedrock institutions in their communities for decades to come. We invest in the strongest charter leaders and networks in the country, and we partner closely with them to sustain excellent outcomes as they grow. Our portfolio continues to serve student populations of roughly 90% students of color and 75% students from low-income backgrounds, and we remain committed to being proximate to the lived experiences of the students and communities we serve.

THE OPPORTUNITY

CSGF’s Policy, Communications & Advocacy team builds the public perception, political will, and sector narrative that allow high-quality public charter schools to grow. As CSGF launches Fund V, the organization envisions a more proactive public voice: one that tells the story of our portfolio networks, positions CSGF as a leading authority in K-12 education reform, and equips our portfolio leaders to communicate with confidence.

CSGF is seeking a Vice President, Communications to set the vision and strategy for CSGF’s internal and external communications and to serve as the organization’s lead strategist for brand, media, and narrative. Reporting to the Managing Director, Policy, Communications and Advocacy (PCA), the VP will shape and drive CSGF’s earned media strategy, build and protect the organization’s reputation with national partners and the broader education reform field, and navigate complex or sensitive communications moments with sound judgment. This is an individual-contributor VP role: the VP will manage CSGF’s communications budget and external partners (agencies, consultants, freelancers) rather than internal staff, and will build deep, trusted relationships across CSGF’s teams, portfolio network leaders, and external stakeholders to advance CSGF’s mission.

The ideal candidate is a sharp and seasoned strategic communicator who can set direction independently, move fluidly between big-picture narrative and hands-on execution, and represent CSGF with credibility to media, funders, public officials and other sector partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

STRATEGIC COMMUNICATIONS & BRAND LEADERSHIP

  • Set the vision and strategy for CSGF’s internal and external communications function, aligning it with CSGF’s mission, Fund V priorities, and organizational goals
  • Shape CSGF’s brand and narrative as a leading voice in the public charter school sector and K-12 education reform, ensuring consistent, high-quality positioning across all communications channels
  • Serve as a trusted communications advisor to the Managing Director of PCA and CSGF’s senior leadership, bringing judgment and foresight to reputational opportunities and risks
  • Lead the development of CSGF’s website and social media channels and content, and other flagship public-facing materials that tell the story of the portfolio’s impact
  • Lead communications community of practice for CSGF portfolio members, including the development of webinars and planning and execution of in person convenings

MEDIA RELATIONS & EARNED MEDIA

  • Hold and maintain existing strong relationships with national and regional education, policy, and philanthropy reporters
  • Drive a proactive earned media strategy that places CSGF’s perspective and portfolio stories in front of key audiences, including prospective portfolio members, funders, public officials and other sector influencers
  • Prepare CSGF spokespeople, including senior leadership and portfolio network leaders, for interviews, testimony, and public appearances
  • Navigate incoming media inquiries with sound judgment, balancing responsiveness with message discipline

MESSAGING & CONTENT DEVELOPMENT

  • Develop compelling, on-message content — op-eds, talking points, speeches, digital/social content, and podcast content — that advances CSGF’s policy and sector priorities
  • Create opportunities for portfolio storytelling that resonate with target audiences including funders, charter sector leaders and policymakers
  • Build message frameworks, guidance, and talking points that CSGF teams and portfolio leaders can use consistently across audiences
  • Guide CSGF’s social media and digital presence, ensuring it reflects a coherent, current, and credible voice

CRISIS & RAPID-RESPONSE COMMUNICATIONS

  • Identify potential reputational risks before they arise and build response plans that protect CSGF and its portfolio network leaders
  • Lead rapid-response communications during fast-moving news cycles or sensitive moments affecting CSGF or the charter sector broadly
  • Exercise sound judgment and comfort with ambiguity when advising leadership on high-stakes or fast-moving communications decisions

CROSS-TEAM PARTNERSHIP & ECOSYSTEM BUILDING

  • Build strong relationships across CSGF internal teams and portfolio members to ensure communications strategy reflects and reinforces their work
  • Support portfolio network leaders in building their own communications capacity and confidence, sharing best practices and benchmarking across the sector
  • Represent CSGF externally to broader stakeholders in the charter school and education reform field, building CSGF’s standing as a sought-after thought partner

BUDGET & VENDOR MANAGEMENT

  • Develop and manage CSGF’s communications budget, ensuring resources are prioritized against the highest-impact opportunities
  • Ability to source, manage and evaluate multiple contracts with communications agencies, consultants, and

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Skills and Requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to independently set strategy and vision for communications function, with minimal oversight
  • Excellent judgment and comfort making difficult, high-stakes decisions under ambiguity and time pressure
  • Exceptional relationship-building and collaborative skills
  • Outstanding writing, editing, and verbal communication skills across a range of formats and audiences
  • Ability to move seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on, detail-oriented execution in a fast paced environment
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and external vendors simultaneously
  • Travel up to 50% may be required to support portfolio communications work, convenings, all-team gatherings, and in-person team meetings
  • Deep commitment to CSGF’s mission and passion for K-12 education and expanding excellent public school options for underserved students

Educational Background and Work Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in strategic communications, media relations, or public affairs
  • Demonstrated success building and executing proactive earned media strategies and managing rapid-response or crisis communications
  • Experience developing and managing a communications budget, including agency and vendor relationships
  • Experience in charters or the K-12 education, advocacy, or the nonprofit/political sector strongly preferred
  • Ability to work with senior leadership team members
  • Bachelor’s degree required

COMPENSATION

Compensation is commensurate with experience and education. The target salary range for this role is $130,000-$160,000 annually. CSGF offers a very competitive package of benefits, including: health, life, disability, and dental insurance coverage; vacation/holidays and parental leave; and participation in CSGF’s 403(b) plan. Candidates must have permanent authorization to work in the US.

START DATE

CSGF is seeking candidates who can start as soon as possible; flexible for the ideal candidate.

WORKING AT CSGF

We are focused on hiring and developing great people and believe that building diverse perspectives across our team makes us more effective in expanding our impact. (This is reflected in Our Commitment Statement.) Our core values are:

Why you'll love working here:

  • Join a team driven by purpose, collaboration, and a commitment to identifying and responding to the needs of the public charter schools that we support
  • Access to professional development and learning opportunities

Our core values are:

Results

  • We believe that student success is the ultimate measure of our performance.
  • We work with urgency and intentionality for the portfolio and their schools.
  • We hold ourselves accountable to strong outcomes.
  • We relentlessly prioritize our resources to drive positive, measurable, attributable impact for the charter leaders, their schools, and ultimately students.
  • We believe strong results come from good decisions, and the best decisions are made when we use data - both quantitative and qualitative - and gather input from diverse perspectives, especially those most impacted by the work.
  • We celebrate our wins and learn from our losses.

Teamwork

  • We value organization over team, and we value team over individual.
  • We actively break down silos and collaborate across teams.
  • We believe building strong, healthy relationships is critical to move our work forward.
  • We seek to proactively communicate across teams to strengthen our outcomes and add value for the portfolio.

Integrity

  • We believe that trust is our most important asset, and we must earn and maintain the trust of the portfolio member leaders, investors, and our team to achieve our goals.
  • We are often entrusted with sensitive and confidential information about the portfolio - we do not ever violate these confidences.
  • We show ownership for our successes and our failures.
  • We speak directly to the person, even when it's messy and hard, and get ahead of potential problems.
  • We do the right thing, even when no one is watching.

Respect

  • We understand and acknowledge our place in the value chain – the students, teachers, principals, and other leaders at portfolio networks are doing the hardest, direct, and most impactful work in their schools each day.
  • We prioritize humility and embrace getting better every day.
  • We are curious and open-minded.
  • We are aware of our own biases and how they might affect our judgment, and we take ownership to mitigate their impact.

Entrepreneurship

  • We take calculated risks, looking for new ways to add value and improve how we work.
  • We are problem solvers in all aspects of our work.
  • We actively connect people and ideas in strategic ways to foster new ideas and learning.
  • We acknowledge not all investments will succeed and embrace failure as it facilitates deeper learning for our organization and the portfolio.

E-VERIFY STATEMENT

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you. Including terminating employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the I-9 form.

Charter School Growth Fund provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees.

About Halborn Inc

Our mission is to provide value-add security services and products to the world’s most cutting edge technology firms and that starts with blockchain tech. Founded in 2019, Halborn is an elite cyber security company focused on solving complex adversarial problems unique to the cryptocurrency and fintech industries. From breaches and social engineering to stolen private keys and economic hacks, Halborn solves it. Our clientele are the exclusive blockchain companies as well as new startups with high growth trajectories.

Our Culture

Halborn is a globally distributed team of 100+, looking to grow our elite team of white hat hackers, sales professionals, security engineers and DevSecOps specialists who value independence, want to make their own hours, work for themselves and have a passion for the ever evolving cryptocurrency industry.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Halborn Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, education, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics and celebrates the diversity of its growing team.

We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas at this time.

Recruitment agencies and consultants may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Halborn does not accept unsolicited agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Halborn Inc.

We are looking for a full stack developer who is comfortable owning a feature from the database schema to the last pixel and who already builds with AI as a core part of how they work, not as a novelty. You will build the platforms our security researchers use to run engagements, the products our clients use to consume findings, and the AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate at a scale that should not be possible. The work is real product engineering against real adversarial conditions, and the security bar is high because our customers are the reason it has to be.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and ship features end to end across a React and TypeScript front end and Python or Node.js services, taking ownership from technical design through production support.
  • Model data and design APIs that hold up as requirements change — clear contracts, sane migrations, and schemas that will not need to be rescued in six months.
  • Build AI-native product capabilities: LLM orchestration, agentic and multi-step workflows, retrieval over engagement data, and structured output that downstream systems can rely on.
  • Use AI coding tooling aggressively in your own development loop while maintaining the review discipline that keeps generated code from becoming a liability.
  • Automate internal engineering and security workflows, turning processes our researchers currently run by hand into durable product surface.
  • Write secure code by default — input validation, authentication and authorization, secrets handling, dependency hygiene — and treat security review as part of shipping, not a gate at the end.
  • Participate in code review as both author and reviewer, raising the standard of the codebase rather than just approving diffs.
  • Deploy and operate what you build: containerized services, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and the on-call ownership that comes with running production systems.
  • Collaborate directly with security researchers, auditors, and product stakeholders to translate deep domain expertise into software that non-experts can use.
  • Contribute to technical direction — framework choices, architecture, and the tradeoffs behind them — and document decisions so the team can move without you in the room.

Qualifications

  • 4 or more years building and shipping production web applications, with genuine ownership on both the front end and the back end.
  • Strong React and TypeScript, including modern state management, component architecture, and CSS competent enough to build an interface without a designer hovering.
  • Strong server-side skills in Python, Node.js, or both, with production experience designing REST or GraphQL APIs.
  • Solid relational database experience — PostgreSQL preferred — including schema design, query performance, and migrations.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Docker, and CI/CD pipelines you configured yourself.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward development practice: you integrate LLM APIs into real products, you use AI coding assistants as part of your daily loop, and you can articulate where they accelerate you and where they need a human.
  • Security-minded engineering instincts and a working understanding of common web vulnerability classes and how to prevent them.
  • Excellent asynchronous written communication and the self-direction to own outcomes across time zones without being managed day to day.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity in a constantly changing and evolving work environment where growth is non-stop.
  • Willingness to learn the technical aspects of blockchain and cybersecurity.

Bonus Points

  • Web3 development experience — ethers.js or viem, wallet integrations, RPC providers, or Solidity and Rust smart contract familiarity.
  • Experience building agentic systems, working with the Model Context Protocol, vector databases, or evaluation frameworks for LLM features.
  • DevSecOps experience: infrastructure as code, secrets management, supply chain security, or automated security scanning in CI.
  • Prior work at a cybersecurity, fintech, or crypto company, or on products handling sensitive customer data.
  • Experience taking a product from zero to one on a small team.
  • Open source contributions.
  • Knowledgeable of the latest trends in Blockchain and DeFi.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking a Technical Content Creator to showcase the practical power of Tether's peer-to-peer stack. This is a builder-centric role designed for an engineer or highly technical creator who bridges the gap between low-level infrastructure, cryptography, and functional application.

We are not looking for a social media marketer or an on-camera influencer. We are looking for a technical storyteller who can write code, spin up peer-to-peer nodes, build functional Bare-powered applications, and record polished, clear, screen-share demos. You will turn our core stack (Pear and Bare) into an ongoing series of visual, practical "build-in-public" prototypes that prove to the world what true decentralized, peer-to-peer infrastructure looks like.

Responsibilities

  • Build Practical Demos: Independently build functional peer-to-peer applications and infrastructure setups using the Pear platform and the Bare runtime with minimal engineering hand-holding.

  • Record Technical Demos: Record clear, engaging, and high-quality screen-share walkthroughs and video demos of your builds, highlighting how the code works, how peers discover and sync with each other, and the value the systems deliver.

  • Translate Code to Content: Turn complex protocol updates, cryptographic primitives, and technical documentation into highly visual, digestible developer content (such as code-along videos, step-by-step guides, and interactive repositories).

  • Collaborate with Core Devs: Work closely with our P2P protocol and product engineering teams to stay ahead of upcoming Pear and Bare features.

  • Prototypes: Rapidly prototype application concepts — such as spinning up a peer-to-peer chat, file-sync, or data-replication demo — to show how quickly developers can launch resilient, serverless products using our ecosystem.

  • Fuel Influencer-Led Developer Adoption: Collaborate with technical influencers, developer advocates, and content creators to amplify our ecosystem. You will provide them with turn-key technical assets, co-create code-along challenges, and arm them with the high-quality demos and prototypes needed to inspire and onboard new developers to Pear and Bare.

Requirements

  • 3 to 6+ years of experience in a technical role such as Technical Content Creation, Solutions Engineering, or Backend/Systems Development.

  • Strong Programming Skills: Proficiency in languages used across our ecosystem (such as NodeJS, C/C++) to interact confidently with peer-to-peer networking and runtime internals.

  • Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of peer-to-peer (P2P) networking, distributed systems, hypercore/append-only-log style data structures, and decentralized application architecture.

  • Demo/Video Production Skills: Experience recording and editing polished technical screen-shares, terminal recordings, or video tutorials (using tools like Loom, Camtasia, Screenflow, etc.).

  • Developer Empathy: The ability to look at a complex P2P protocol or runtime and understand exactly what kind of demo or sample project will get developers and infrastructure operators excited to start building.

  • Self-Starter Mindset: Comfortable working autonomously in a remote, distributed environment across global time zones.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Technical Solutions Engineering (TSE) team is the glue that supports our developer-users and champions developer experience as being central to the overall experience of our users. TSE interacts directly with developer-users more than any other team at Stripe, so your role will have a significant impact on what Stripe is known for and values most. When we do our job well, developers all over the world are able to smoothly launch and grow their businesses on Stripe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex financial systems.

What you’ll do

TSEs understand the fundamentals of programming incredibly well and eagerly jump in and familiarize themselves with others’ code. You will do a wide variety of things, including explaining technical concepts about Stripe’s products, build and debug integrations with developers, and produce/improve guides that help our users solve particular problems to be successful with Stripe. You will interact with developers of all skill levels through a variety of mediums, enabling them to be successful when using Stripe.

Early on, current team members will devote a large amount of time to teaching you and helping you get to a level of comfort and expertise with Stripe, its services, and how we interact with users. Later, we’d love for you to take on this role with others on the team and Stripes broadly, as teaching is a great way to learn and to reinforce what you know.

If you’re someone who enjoys working with all kinds of code, is a fast researcher, a strong writer, and enthusiastic about helping others build mission-critical products with Stripe, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with a number of external developers and aid them in building their applications against Stripe’s infrastructure in a number of programming languages (including Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, NodeJS, .NET, ReactJS, React Native, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, and Java for Android).
  • Unblock external developers with their thorniest integration challenges through a variety of support channels including email, ticketing software, internal issue trackers, community platforms (like StackOverflow), and real-time chat software (like Slack and Discord)
  • Develop and maintain internal and external documentation, examples, integration demos, and code-snippets that demonstrate usage patterns of the Stripe infrastructure.
  • Identify points of friction developers encounter and collaborate with engineering teams to make Stripe products better. Participate in a number of extended engineering teams’ regular planning sessions, design reviews, and development meetings.
  • Develop and maintain a suite of internal support tooling for TSE and Stripe Support more broadly e.g. a retrieval augmented generation LLM-based Copilot tool or the Invoice Explainer Admin tool.
  • Act as a developer advocate and educational resource internal to the organization by regularly assembling training for non-developers internal to the organization and responding in real-time to product integration questions.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

This role is remote but requires candidates to be located in the Mountain or Pacific time zones.

Minimum requirements

  • At least 4 years of full-stack software development experience, with a proven track record of building web or mobile applications that deliver high-quality user experiences
  • Direct experience explaining technical concepts, and would be comfortable explaining how Stripe works to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Understands how to write good, clean code in multiple programming languages, as well as how to read code that might not be quite as well written
  • Ability to help users during working hours in the region you are in. This may occasionally include providing weekend coverage for monitoring/supporting critical infrastructure, which TSEs are uniquely equipped to assist with given the team’s knowledge around Stripe’s products and active integrations. The team is largely remote, and we are very supportive of working arrangements that allow for family care and other needs to be met.

Preferred qualifications

  • Enjoys writing in a clear and quick manner
  • General software engineering skills are important to us, as we understand that new languages and frameworks can be learned if you understand the concepts
  • Experience teaching or coaching developers
  • Comfort working with a great deal of autonomy and limited supervision
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software/Computer Engineering, or a related analytical field of study

About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Penetration Testing Analyst 2 to join our Red Team. The Sophos Red Team is engaged by organizations worldwide to identify and exploit vulnerabilities within client environments, applying information security threat intelligence to uncover the same weaknesses real-world adversaries would target.

As a Senior Penetration Testing Analyst, you will focus on either application security (web application penetration testing, mobile, API testing) or network security (vulnerability assessments, external penetration tests, internal penetration tests, etc.), using both off-the-shelf and internally developed tools to execute manual testing for advanced attacks. Candidates are not expected to be experienced in both focus areas, although that would be a plus.

In this role, you will produce professional security assessment reports detailing vulnerability and exploit information for clients, and will lead client-facing calls throughout each engagement, from project kick-off through notification of high and critical findings to a close-out review of test findings, evidence, process steps to reproduce, and remediation recommendations.

The ideal candidate for this role will bring strong technical communication skills, sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, and a proactive approach to researching new threats, vulnerabilities, and exploits.

You will excel as both a self-directed individual contributor and as a member of a larger team, performing other essential duties as assigned.

What you will do

  • This is a remote position with potential travel up to 10%
  • Conduct application security assessments (web, mobile, API, etc.) using off-the-shelf or internally developed exploitation tools to execute manual testing for advanced attacks OR network penetration testing assessments (external pen test, internal pen test, etc.)
  • Produce and deliver vulnerability and exploit information to clients in the form of a professional security assessment report
  • Conduct client conference calls, including but not limited to project kick-off calls, notification of high/critical findings during the testing process, and close-out calls to review test findings, evidence, process steps to reproduce, and remediation recommendations
  • Perform proactive research to identify and understand new threats, vulnerabilities, and exploits
  • Conduct exploitation testing using off-the-shelf or self-developed exploitation tools and document findings for client remediation
  • Excel as both a self-directed individual contributor and as a member of a larger team
  • Perform other essential duties as assigned

What you will bring

    • Typically requires 6+ years of related experience in a professional role with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5+ years with a Master’s degree; or 3+ years with a PhD; or equivalent experience.
    • Minimum of 4 years of experience with penetration testing
    • Minimum of 4 years of experience with at least one of the following: Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Burp Suite
      • Offensive certifications such as CEH, WAPT, GPEN, GWAPT, GAWN, OSCP, etc.

        • Desirable:

      • Knowledge of NetSparker and AppScan; operating systems administration and internals (Microsoft Windows / Linux)
        • Experience with various application attack vectors, security test processes, and strong knowledge of common vulnerabilities (i.e. OWASP Top 10)
        • Understanding of TCP/IP networking at a technical level
        • Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent professional experience
        • Working knowledge of SQL and high-level languages
        • Good technical communication skills, both written and verbal; good analytical and problem-solving skills

An overview of this role

The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but they can also produce passing test suites for software that doesn't work as intended. As a Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll own the technical thesis for closing that validation gap and build the early proof yourself. You'll rethink what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy enough that teams choose to adopt it.

  • Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy.
  • Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions.
  • Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language.
  • Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, fed straight back into the platform.

What you’ll do

  • Own the technical thesis for how GitLab validates software when an agent is the author, and turn it into an architecture the team can build against.
  • Prototype the hard parts by building early versions of feedback mechanisms that catch the gap between passing tests and working software, proving what works before the team scales it.
  • Develop approaches for GitLab's primary stacks, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, under one shared definition of "trusted," while allowing the right technique to differ by language.
  • Design the mid-loop feedback an agent needs to self-correct toward working software rather than green assertions, and build the systems that deliver it.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to adopt these approaches, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those findings to improve the platform.
  • Set technical direction the team can build on, review designs, and help teammates grow their technical judgment.

What you’ll bring

  • Deep, current, hands-on experience building real software with artificial intelligence agents, ideally across more than one language, and a clear understanding of why agent output can pass tests yet fail in production.
  • A strong point of view on the validation gap and concrete ideas for closing it, backed by approaches you've built or tried.
  • The technical range to design systems rather than tune a single framework, and the judgment to know when a solution should be general or language-specific.
  • You prototype to learn, and you ship.
  • The ability to influence engineers across an organization without formal authority through working code and sound reasoning.
  • Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.
  • Alignment with GitLab's values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency.

This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We aren't looking for depth in a particular testing framework. We're looking for someone who has built with agents, experienced the validation gap firsthand, and wants to solve it.

About the team

The Trusted Agentic Development team is part of GitLab's Developer Experience group. We build platforms and practices that help GitLab engineers validate agent-generated software with confidence. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt.

OCI Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure

At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

Anaplan is seeking an Enterprise Account Executive (German speaking) to drive its growth and expand its presence in Germany, wherever you are! We want to hear from you!

In this role, you will take your proven track record of selling sophisticated technology solutions and account management and sell an incredibly versatile platform. Our sales team is helping industry leaders understand the impact of Anaplan products and how our connected planning solution is ending siloed decision-making. You will help our customers achieve their immediate business goals while setting their business up for the future.

This role will be a catalyst to Anaplan’s continued growth while leading digital transformation. Reporting directly to the RVP of Sales. You will have mostly greenfield accounts. This type of territory requires someone to further build our footprint by hunting and locking in new logo accounts, as well as rapidly growing opportunities within the current customer base.

Your Impact

  • Engaging with targeted prospects and clients to identify broken business processes and position Anaplan’s unique ability to solve the problem,
  • Build Anaplan’s business value throughout the selling engagement. Navigating sophisticated prospect environments to align the prospect around the Anaplan solution,
  • Conduct highly effective presentations from Director through SVP and key C-suite level decision makers including CFOs, CROs, and senior leaders in supply chain, workforce, and other business functions,
  • Develop customers and own opportunity management start-to-finish across multiple customer targets and functions,
  • Apply Anaplan’s value-based selling methodology and tools to run sales processes and accurately forecast business,
  • Employ outstanding account leadership skills to identify account expansion opportunities by cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within targeted accounts,
  • Perform strategic sales planning, leading to accurate forecasting of the business,
  • Work with cross-functional members of Sales Development Reps, Marketing, Solution Consultants, and the Customer Success teams.

Your Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in consultative sales to Fortune 2000 companies, ideally in SaaS solutions (but not required),
  • Shown success selling into Vice President / Senior Vice President buyers,
  • Track record of overachieving sales quota & targets, including demonstrated history of multiple high six-figure annual contract value (ACV) deals (services and/or software),
  • Demonstrated network in your industry territory, with a mix of some customers and implementation partners,
  • Demonstrated experience with sophisticated partner & internal team organizations,
  • Domain understanding (Supply Chain, FP&A, Workforce Planning & Sales) and knowledge of how these functions plan, process work and make decisions,
  • Strong, demonstrated opportunity management practices (e.g. sales process, qualification, executive presentation skills, quote presentation and negotiation), and ability to balance multiple (3-5) opportunities at once,
  • Business, Finance, Economics, related BS/BA degree or relevant years of experience.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Outreach, SFDC, LinkedIn Sales Navigator a plus,
  • Account Planning experience Altify, MEDDPICC, Miller Heiman.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer 

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not: 

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. 

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.  

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

RemotePass exists because talent is distributed equally, but opportunity is not. Backed by EBRD and trusted by 800+ companies across 150+ countries, RemotePass is the platform that gives businesses the infrastructure to hire anyone, anywhere — and gives workers in emerging markets the financial tools and global access they deserve.

RemotePass is the only platform that combines Employer of Record, contractor management, direct employment, and corporate spend cards in a single product — rated 4.8/5 on G2, trusted by Spotify, Logitech, and Deloitte, and operating across 150+ countries. We are backed by leading global investors, including Oraseya Capital, Endeavor Catalyst, Khwarizmi Ventures, Flyer One Ventures, Access Bridge Ventures, A15, Swiss Founders Fund, and Plug & Play.

The role

As RemotePass scales, we are adding a Compliance Operations Lead to strengthen the bridge between our Head of Compliance, Operations, and the analyst team. This person will handle ambiguous cases, keep day-to-day execution moving, and ensure compliance decisions are consistent, well-documented, and defensible.

This role is flexible by design. If you want to manage the analyst team directly, we're open to that. If you'd rather come in as a senior individual contributor who's simply the team's first point of escalation, that works too — we'll shape the role around the right person. What matters more than the org chart is the operational judgment: the ability to look at an incomplete document set, a vague business description, or an unusual payment pattern, and know exactly what to do with it.

What you'll do

  • Be the first escalation point for complex KYB, KYC, and enhanced due diligence cases, before anything reaches the Head of Compliance
  • Review and QA analyst decisions — risk ratings, evidence, disposition notes — to make sure they're complete and defensible
  • Set and track team SLAs and KPIs: case aging, turnaround times, QA findings, rework rates
  • Build and maintain SOPs, escalation templates, and case documentation standards as the team scales
  • Manage sanctions, PEP, and adverse media escalations, including false-positive review and evidence retention
  • Support transaction monitoring — spotting unusual payout patterns, rapid onboarding, or high-risk activity
  • Maintain our compliance evidence register and issue/remediation tracker for audits and partner reviews
  • Coordinate with Customer Success and Operations so client-facing compliance requests stay clear and commercially practical
  • Report on compliance operations to our Head of Compliance and COO

Requirements

  • 5+ years in compliance operations, AML/financial crime, sanctions, or payments compliance — ideally with experience at a licensed money transmitter, payment institution, bank, PSP, fintech, card/spend platform, marketplace, or other regulated financial services environment.
  • Comfortable making calls on ambiguous cases: incomplete documents, unclear business activity, or elevated payment partner risk
  • Able to clearly separate a documentation gap from real risk from something that needs to go straight to the Head of Compliance
  • Experience managing, mentoring, or QA'ing analysts is a strong plus — not required
  • Strong written communication: case notes, escalation summaries, and partner responses that hold up under scrutiny
  • CAMS or CFCS certification is a plus
  • Arabic fluency is a strong plus, not a requirement

Benefits

  • Remote-First Culture: We don't just sell remote work; we live it. Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Hyper-Growth: Be part of a company that is consistently recognized for its rapid expansion and innovation.
  • Inclusion Matters: We are committed to building a diverse team. We value different perspectives and empower every individual to bring their authentic self to work.

The Director, Financial Reporting is responsible for leading the preparation and delivery of accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting for a publicly traded mortgage company. This role is responsible for SEC Reporting, regulatory filings and Accounting Policy.

The Director serves as a key leader within the Finance organization, partnering closely with Accounting Operations, Treasury, Capital Markets, Servicing, Originations, FP&A, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and External Audit teams to support high-quality financial reporting, internal controls, and strategic business initiatives.

This position plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity of the company’s financial statements, evaluating complex transactions,

  • Drive process improvement, standardization, and automation initiatives across financial reporting processes to increase reporting accuracy, efficiency, scalability, and governance.

  • Promote best practices for reporting documentation, review procedures, data integrity, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop financial reporting professionals, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and professional development plans.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must have the following education and/or experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.

jobs.title: Growth BA
jobs.excerpt: Sobre a ZippiEstamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.
jobs.description:
Sobre a Zippi

Estamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.

Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito, permitindo que MPEs acessem capital de giro de forma instantânea. Com apenas um toque, nossos clientes conseguem pagar despesas do negócio e ainda contar com até 10 dias para pagar, garantindo um fluxo de caixa consistente para suas operações.

Desde o nosso lançamento, há quatro anos, alcançamos a lucratividade e vivemos um período de crescimento exponencial. Até hoje, já concedemos mais de R$ 10 bilhões em crédito para micro e pequenos negócios em todo o Brasil. Estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de capital de giro no mercado brasileiro de MPBs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 3,5 trilhões por ano. Assim como os cartões de crédito transformaram o consumo, a Zippi está redefinindo a forma como os pequenos negócios gerenciam seu fluxo de caixa — com acesso instantâneo, integração fluida e soluções construídas para necessidades reais do dia a dia.

Nosso sucesso é impulsionado por uma abordagem altamente automatizada e baseada em dados. Construímos uma infraestrutura tecnológica avançada, capaz de processar grandes volumes de dados de pagamentos e crédito, o que nos permite realizar a análise de risco, a liberação e a cobrança de crédito em escala, mantendo unit economics sólidos. Gerenciamos todo o ciclo de crédito internamente, alavancando ciência de dados de ponta para tomar decisões em tempo real com alto nível de precisão.

Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, formamos um time de tecnologia de calibre global focado em construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar. Se você busca a oportunidade de gerar impacto real em uma causa que vale a pena, em uma das startups que mais crescem em mercados emergentes, atuando em uma oportunidade multibilionária — a Zippi é o lugar certo para você.

Sobre o Time

Growth é a grande alavanca para materializar a ambição da Zippi de dobrar de tamanho novamente em 2026, depois de já ter dobrado em 2025. Dentro de Growth, Mídia Paga é um dos motores centrais de aquisição, operando hoje três canais ativos - Meta, Google e TikTok - com espaço para aprofundar cada um deles e abrir novas frentes.

Essa é uma cadeira para dar à operação analítica de mídia paga a dedicação e o rigor que o momento de hipercrescimento exige: mais testes, mais leitura de dados, mais velocidade de iteração, cada vez mais suportados por agentes de IA. Você vai atuar em parceria próxima com quem já toca essa operação, dividindo a responsabilidade em pé de igualdade e com autonomia para assumir canais próprios desde o início.

Sua Missão

  1. Ownership de Canais: assumir a operação analítica de canais de mídia paga (Meta, Google, TikTok) de ponta a ponta, leitura de performance, hipóteses de teste e rotina de otimização, respondendo por eficiência (pCAC/ROAS) e volume.
  2. Expansão para Novas Frentes: estruturar e liderar o setup analítico de novos canais, como Kwai e DSPs, trazendo benchmarks de fora para acelerar decisões e abrir frentes que hoje ficam de lado por falta de capacidade dedicada.
  3. Automação e IA Aplicada: construir e evoluir agentes de IA e automações, relatórios recorrentes, alertas de anomalia, puxadas de dados, que acelerem a análise e a operação de mídia paga, incluindo ferramentas internas de growth já em uso.
  4. Elevação de Repertório: trazer práticas e frameworks de User Acquisition de mercado, estrutura de conta, medição e incrementalidade, ciclo de criativos, que se tornem padrão na forma como a Zippi opera mídia paga.

O que buscamos

  • Experiência em User Acquisition e Mídia Paga: track record real gerindo budget relevante em pelo menos um canal principal (Meta, Google, TikTok ou DSPs), com histórico de escalar investimento mantendo eficiência.
  • Raciocínio quantitativo e domínio de métricas de aquisição: fluência em CAC/pCAC, ROAS, CPM e CVR por etapa de funil, com autonomia para investigar performance em planilhas e SQL (ou ferramentas de BI) sem depender de terceiros.
  • Fluência prática em IA: usa IA ativamente no dia a dia e tem interesse genuíno em construir agentes e automações que acelerem análise e operação.
  • Ownership de ponta a ponta: disposição para assumir um canal com autonomia, propor formato e tocar rotina operacional em um ambiente ainda em construção.
  • Comunicação e repertório de mercado: traduz análise em recomendação clara, defende hipóteses com dados e traz benchmarks e provocações de fora, sem soberba.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência abrindo canais novos (Kwai, DSPs, programática) do zero;
  • Vivência com medição/incrementalidade (geo tests, MMM, holdouts) e com MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust);
  • Experiência com automações (n8n, Zapier), scripts (Python) ou construção de agentes de IA.

Por que vir para a Zippi

  • Uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar: nossa missão é ajudar micro e pequenas empresas a prosperar. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente 22 milhões de empreendedores brasileiros, ampliando o acesso financeiro em um mercado enorme e carente de soluções.
  • Ownership e construção desde o primeiro dia: como um early team member, você terá papel essencial na criação da área de crescimento de uma startup lucrativa, bem financiada e apoiada por investidores de renome como Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Globo Ventures e Volpe Capital.
  • Aprendizado acelerado com gente boa: aqui você terá a oportunidade de se envolver em projetos estratégicos e enfrentar desafios complexos ao lado de fundadores e operadores de fintechs de ponta. Nossos times são colaborativos, atuam com autonomia e carregam um alto grau de responsabilidade.

O que você pode esperar da gente

  • Remuneração na faixa alta de mercado;
  • Learning Budget anual;
  • Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela Zippi para você e para dependentes até 18 anos. Para cônjuges e companheiros(as), cobrimos 50% da mensalidade;
  • Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos;
  • Vale-refeição no Caju;
  • Férias flexíveis;
  • Wellhub e Zenklub;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a highly organized and persistent Payoff Coordinator to manage the ordering, tracking, and follow-up of mortgage payoff statements for our loan pipeline. This is a high-volume, detail-intensive role that requires someone who is disciplined about follow-through, comfortable making repeated contact with mortgage servicers and lenders, and meticulous about keeping records accurate and current.

The core of this role is simple but demands consistency: order payoffs, follow up, follow up again, and do not stop until every payoff is received, verified, and in the file. If something has not come back, you reach out again — by phone, by email, or both — until it does. Nothing sits unresolved. Nothing is forgotten.

Key Responsibilities

Payoff Ordering

  • Order payoff statements from mortgage companies, lenders, and servicers for all applicable loans in the pipeline
  • Ensure each payoff request is submitted with accurate loan information — borrower name, loan number, property address, and requested payoff date
  • Track every payoff order from the moment it is submitted to the moment it is received and confirmed in the file
  • Order updated or extended payoff statements when closing dates change or existing payoffs are approaching expiration
  • Maintain an organized log of all outstanding and completed payoff orders so nothing falls through the cracks

Follow-Up — Persistent & Consistent

This is the most important function of the role.

  • Follow up by phone and email with mortgage servicers and lenders on all outstanding payoff requests
  • Establish and maintain a consistent follow-up cadence — if a payoff has not been received within the expected window, you reach back out immediately
  • Escalate when a servicer is unresponsive or a payoff is at risk of delaying closing — bring it to the supervisor's attention with full context
  • Re-order payoffs when statements expire and closing has been extended — proactively, before the team has to ask
  • Document every follow-up attempt — date, time, contact name, method, and outcome — so there is always a clear record of where each request stands

Payoff Verification & File Management

  • Review received payoff statements for accuracy — verify loan balances, per diem amounts, good-through dates, and wire instructions
  • Flag any discrepancies or concerns to the processing or closing team immediately
  • Ensure all payoff statements are properly saved and organized in the loan file system
  • Confirm that payoffs received are still valid as closing dates approach and initiate re-orders when needed

Communication & Coordination

  • Communicate payoff status updates to loan officers, processors, and closing teams in a clear and timely manner
  • Respond promptly to internal requests for payoff status, document retrieval, or re-ordering
  • Maintain professional, clear, and effective communication with mortgage servicers and lenders on every outreach

Required Qualifications

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail — accurate records and zero missed follow-ups are the standard in this role
  • Persistent and proactive follow-through — you are comfortable making repeated contact with the same party until you get what you need
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for professional interaction with mortgage servicers, lenders, and internal teams
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of concurrent tasks and open items without losing track of any
  • Self-directed and reliable in a remote environment — you manage your own follow-up schedule and do not need to be reminded
  • Proficient in email, spreadsheet tracking, and document management tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in mortgage processing, loan operations, title, or a related role — familiarity with payoff statements, per diem calculations, and good-through dates is a strong advantage
  • Experience ordering payoffs directly from mortgage servicers or using servicer portals
  • Background in a high-volume loan pipeline environment
  • Familiarity with loan origination systems (LOS) or document management platforms used in mortgage operations

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Every payoff in your queue has a status, a follow-up date, and a record of every contact made — always
  • You re-order before anyone asks — because you already saw the expiration date coming
  • When a servicer goes quiet, you pick up the phone — and then you send the email too
  • The processing and closing team never has to chase you for a payoff update because you have already sent it
  • You are the reason loans close on time — because payoffs are never the bottleneck on your watch

Requirements

This is a full time job

Rate is $6/hr

    With a strong focus on Heart Failure management and Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT), you’ll assess patients, develop and adjust treatment plans, monitor disease progression, and work closely with cardiologists, primary care providers, and other members of the care team. You’ll combine clinical expertise with education, advocacy, and evidence-based practice to help patients better manage their cardiovascular health and achieve improved long-term outcomes.

  • Patient Assessment: Conduct thorough patient assessments via telehealth visits, including medical history reviews, physical examinations, and diagnostic tests, to evaluate cardiovascular health and identify cardiac conditions.

  • Disease & Heart Failure Management: Extensively manage chronic cardiovascular conditions remotely, with a heavy emphasis on advanced Heart Failure management, hypertension, arrhythmias, and coronary artery disease. Monitor patient progress, analyze real-time data, and adjust care pathways to optimize cardiac function and prevent hospital readmissions.

  • Research and Evidence-Based Practice: Stay current with the latest developments in cardiology research and incorporate evidence-based practices into patient care. Participate in research studies or quality improvement initiatives to enhance patient outcomes.

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate and detailed patient records, including medical histories, assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and discharge summaries. Ensure compliance with legal and ethical standards.

  • Patient Advocacy: Serve as an advocate for patients' needs and preferences, ensuring that they receive appropriate care and support throughout their healthcare journey.

  • Continuing Education: Pursue ongoing education and professional development in the field of cardiology to stay updated on the latest advancements and maintain relevant certifications.

  • Availability: Must be able to work Monday through Friday, 9 am to 5 pm EST.

About You

  • Certification: Obtain and maintain Nurse Practitioner (NP) certification specific to cardiology from a recognized certifying body, such as the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) or the American Academy of Nurse Practitioners Certification Board (AANPCB), in a relevant Nurse Practitioner specialty (e.g., Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner or Family Nurse Practitioner with a strong focus on cardiology).

  • Оцінювати теми та продуктові гіпотези, які знаходить AI.
  • Перевіряти й челенджити результати AI.
  • Вибирати сильних лекторів.
  • Вести переговори до фінальної домовленості.
  • Доводити програму до потрібної якості.

Важливо: ми оцінюватимемо не кількість проведених досліджень або створених документів, а якість продуктів і швидкість, з якою вони доходять до ринку.

Кого шукаємо:

Продуктове мислення

  • Ти вмієш дивитися на тему очима ринку й аудиторії. Розумієш різницю між цікавою ідеєю та продуктом, за який треба ринку саме зараз.

Сильний judgment

  • Умієш працювати з великою кількістю згенерованої інформації, бачити сильні сигнали, знаходити суперечності та приймати рішення. Не потребуєш повної визначеності, щоб рухатися вперед.

Швидкість

  • Не перетворюєш дослідження та створення програми на нескінченний процес. Умієш визначити, коли результат уже достатньо сильний для наступного кроку, і не затягуєш рішення через прагнення до абстрактної досконалості.

Високі стандарти якості

  • Швидкість для тебе не означає поверхневість. Ти можеш швидко помітити слабку концепцію, недостатньо сильного лектора або програму, яка не дасть студенту потрібного результату.

Переговори та комунікація

  • Тобі комфортно написати незнайомому засновнику, C-level керівнику або сильному галузевому експерту. Ти можеш зацікавити людину ідеєю, провести зустріч, відпрацювати заперечення та домовитися про співпрацю.

Що для нас означає AI-Native:

Ми не шукаємо людину, яка просто вміє писати промпти або час від часу користується ChatGPT.

І також не очікуємо, що ти самостійно побудуєш усі необхідні AI-інструменти — вони вже є.

Нам потрібна людина, яка:

  • швидко опанує наші AI-продукти;
  • використовуватиме їх як основний робочий інструмент;
  • умітиме правильно спрямовувати систему;
  • перевірятиме її висновки;
  • помічатиме слабкі місця;
  • даватиме зворотний зв’язок для покращення флоу;
  • не виконуватиме вручну те, що вже може зробити AI;
  • не передаватиме AI відповідальність за фінальне рішення.

AI створює швидкість і масштаб. Ти забезпечуєш якість і правильний вибір.

Буде плюсом:

  • досвід створення освітніх або digital-продуктів;
  • досвід у переговорах;
  • досвід у стартапах або іншому динамічному середовищі;
  • робота з AI-продуктами, агентами чи автоматизованими процесами.

Нам не принципово, як називалася твоя попередня посада.

Важливіше, чи вмієш ти бачити ринкову можливість, приймати рішення, домовлятися з людьми та створювати якісний продукт.

Benefits

Що ми пропонуємо:

  • віддалений формат роботи;
  • доступ до всіх курсів Laba Group для тебе та твоїх рідних після чотирьох місяців роботи;
  • компенсацію навчання, спорту, техніки та ментального здоров’я;
  • оплачувані лікарняні;
  • оплачувану відпустку;
  • реальні можливості кар’єрного розвитку;
  • команду, яка підтримає і в робочих задачах, і мемами ❤️

Тепер ти знаєш про нас більше.

А ми хочемо дізнатися більше про тебе: заповнюй коротку форму — і го розвивати EdTech разом

jobs.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

Modern engineering teams invest a significant amount of time and money on simulation. Before anything gets built, teams need confidence that a design is going to work: structurally, thermally, aerodynamically, etc. Simulation is one of the main ways they build that confidence.

But the way teams share and review simulation results to make decisions is still pretty broken. Engineers are exporting videos, taking screenshots, dropping them into PowerPoint, and then trying to make decisions through email threads, meetings, or disconnected slide decks. The actual decision-making ends up separated from the underlying simulation data, which means context gets lost, feedback is hard to trace, and important engineering knowledge disappears into the workflow.

CoLab already helps engineering teams review CAD, capture feedback, and make better design decisions in one connected workspace. Now we’re extending that same idea into simulation. The goal is simple: make simulation results collaborative, reviewable, and traceable in the same way CoLab does for CAD today.

We’re starting a new product team focused on bringing simulation review into CoLab. As one of the first engineers on that team, you’ll help define how simulation data gets ingested, visualized, discussed, and connected back to real engineering decisions. There are a lot of interesting technical problems here: large datasets, high-performance visualization, viewer interactions, data pipelines, and user experiences that need to work for mechanical engineers doing critical product development work.

The first phase is about learning the product, the customers, and the review workflows we already support today. You’ll spend time embedded with our Engineering Reviews team, learning how engineers collaborate in CoLab, where the current product is strong, and where simulation creates a new set of problems we need to solve. From there, you’ll help build the foundation for a new Simulation team - not just technically, but from a product perspective as well. We want to build something customers actually need and will use in their day-to-day work, and that requires a highly product oriented approach.

Our Ideal Candidate

You're the kind of developer who wants to understand why a feature matters before deciding how to build it.

You enjoy owning complex technical problems, but you also enjoy talking with product managers, designers, and customers to understand what success actually looks like. You make thoughtful technical decisions independently and know when to bring others into the conversation.

Experience working with simulation software is a significant advantage. Maybe you've worked with FEA, CFD, multiphysics simulations, scientific visualization, or engineering data platforms. You understand the kinds of problems engineers are trying to solve.

This is a good fit for someone who likes ambiguity, wants to work closely with our product and leadership teams, and cares about the connection between technical decisions and customer value. You’ll have a meaningful role in shaping both the architecture and the user experience for a new capability that we think can become a major part of engineering review in CoLab.

What You'll Do

  • Help design and build CoLab's next-generation simulation review capabilities.
  • Build services that ingest and process simulation data from industry-standard engineering software.
  • Develop high-performance visualization experiences capable of displaying large simulation datasets.
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, and customers to validate ideas before building them.
  • Spend time embedded with the Engineering Reviews team to develop deep product and customer understanding before transitioning onto the Simulation team.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that will shape this product area for years to come.
  • Improve performance, scalability, and reliability as simulation capabilities grow.
  • Collaborate with engineers across the platform to ensure simulation becomes a seamless part of the broader CoLab experience.

Qualifications

We're looking for someone with:

  • 8+ years building production software in a modern engineering environment.
  • Strong experience designing scalable backend systems and customer-facing applications.
  • Experience building complex data visualization or graphics-intensive applications.
  • The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with teammates.
  • A product mindset - you think about customer outcomes as much as technical implementation.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex ideas clearly.
  • Experience with Finite Element Analysis (FEA), CFD, or other CAE workflows.
  • Experience with engineering simulation platforms
  • Experience with CAD, PLM, or engineering software development.
  • Large engineering datasets and high-performance rendering.

The Extra Details

  • Full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package, including stock options.
  • Extended health benefits, unlimited paid vacation, and RRSP/401K matching.
  • Remote-first across North America

Equity Note

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification - your potential is what matters most to us.
