jobs.title: Head of Engineering, POS Application Platform
jobs.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why South Africa

South Africa has one of the strongest engineering communities anywhere in the world, and we are deliberately growing our technology organisation in the country. We already have several team members based here. The work is fully remote, and the mission we are working on is close to home.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, POS Apps to join us in South Africa.

About the role

More than 6 million businesses run their financial lives through Moniepoint - and the primary way they interact with us every single day is through a POS device. For most of our merchants, that device is their business. It is how they accept payments, how they access credit, and how they track their finances. Everything those devices are capable of, in terms of speed, reliability, and developer quality, flows from the engineering platform this role leads.

We are building a dedicated POS Application Platform function: the foundational Kotlin-based engineering layer that sits beneath every POS product at Moniepoint. Think of it as the operating system for our POS engineering organisation - the standards, frameworks, tooling, and architectural backbone that every POS engineer across the business builds on top of. This is not a feature team. It is a platform team in the truest sense, and the Head of Engineering for POS Application Platform is the technical owner of that layer.

We currently operate across five POS device types from multiple OEM manufacturers, all running on Android. The engineering challenges here span device governance, developer experience, platform reliability, foundational frameworks, and adoption across a distributed set of POS engineers working in separate product squads.

And the scope is growing. We have a UK entity live, a cross-border payments product in market, and a microfinance bank acquisition which just finalized in Kenya. The platform you build will become the foundation for tens of millions of businesses across multiple markets to accept payments, access financial services, and grow. If you have spent your career going deep on POS systems and you want to build the platform that underpins one of Africa's most consequential fintech businesses during its expansion, this is the role.

What you'll get to do

  • Own the technical strategy and architecture for the POS Application Platform, acting as the domain CTO for everything that runs on our POS devices.
  • Build and govern the four core platform pillars across the organisation: developer experience (tools, libraries, SDKs), platform reliability (observability, uptime, quality standards), foundational frameworks (architecture, coding standards, testing and release pipelines), and squad adoption (driving uptake of platform tooling across all embedded POS engineers).
  • Define and enforce engineering standards across all POS device types and OEM manufacturers, ensuring architectural consistency and quality across a heterogeneous device fleet.
  • Functionally lead POS engineers embedded across Payments, Onboarding, VAS, Savings, and Loans squads - setting the bar for engineering quality and providing the platform layer above all of them.
  • Own POS observability end-to-end: monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks that ensure platform health across all devices and squads.
  • Drive the architecture for how Moniepoint supports multiple POS device types, including defining how new devices are onboarded, governed, and integrated with the platform.
  • Collaborate with OEM partners and the POS hardware team when new device types are introduced, ensuring the application layer is ready to support them from day one.
  • Build and scale the POS platform team, including hiring, mentoring, and structuring for growth as the platform expands internationally.
  • Translate platform decisions into business impact, working closely with Product, Payments, and Business leadership across markets.
  • Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, tooling standards, CI/CD pipelines, and developer productivity metrics across the POS engineering community.

To succeed in this role, we think you should have

  • A minimum of 10 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 6 years leading engineering teams through meaningful growth phases, ideally in multi-national or large VC-backed companies.
  • Direct, hands-on experience building software that runs on Point-of-Sale terminal devices. This means engineering on the device itself — the application layer — not server-side integrations with POS systems. This is a non-negotiable requirement and candidates without it will not be considered.
  • Strong working knowledge of EMV standards (Europay, Mastercard, Visa) and experience navigating payment certification processes such as PCI DSS and P2PE. Candidates without this will not be considered.
  • Deep Android engineering expertise in Kotlin and Java. The POS application layer at Moniepoint is Android-based and there are no exceptions to this requirement.
  • Proven experience building internal engineering platforms, shared libraries, developer tooling, or foundational frameworks used by other engineering teams — not just consumer-facing feature products.
  • Experience governing or architecting across multiple POS device types from different hardware manufacturers, with an understanding of how OEM integrations and device management work at scale.
  • Experience building or maturing platform engineering functions, including establishing engineering processes, tooling strategies, and cross-squad governance structures.
  • Demonstrated ability to scale engineering teams and build the organisational layer beneath you — leaders who can grow into and around the role you are hiring into.
  • Experience at a company processing high volumes of financial transactions in a regulated environment. Fintech background is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with terminal management systems and device observability tooling is a strong advantage.
  • Backend engineering experience in Java or Spring Boot is a strong plus given the breadth of the platform and the integration surface it sits on.
  • Experience working directly with OEM vendors on hardware specification and integration is a bonus.
  • Exposure to C or C++ is a plus — one of our device variants uses C.
  • Experience at Series A or B stage startups alone is unlikely to reflect the scale and complexity required for this role.

Cultural Alignment

We assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Deep empathy for the people depending on the platform — whether that is a merchant in Lagos trying to accept a payment, or a POS engineer blocked by missing tooling. You solve problems quickly and intuitively. You close loops by fixing root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: You have mastered your domain at the fundamentals level. You make trade-offs explicit, reason from first principles, and consistently produce solutions that are better than typical.
  • Systemisation: You convert recurring decisions into repeatable mechanisms. You reduce cognitive load for others. You strengthen institutional memory and improve engineering quality at scale.
  • Urgency: You move with disciplined speed. You act without waiting for permission when you are within scope. You escalate early when risk exceeds your authority. You remove friction and close loops.
  • Ownership: You treat the platform as yours to solve regardless of job description boundaries. You take responsibility without being asked. You follow through on commitments without being reminded.
  • No Ego: You put the mission ahead of personal status. You credit others genuinely, welcome challenge, and never protect your position at the expense of collective outcomes.
  • Candour: You surface reality early, clearly, and completely — especially when it is uncomfortable. You name risks before they become crises. Intelligent failure is acceptable; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Truthfulness and ethical consistency in everything. You adhere to rules and obligations. You never perform under intimidation or corrosive behaviour. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

Some of the technologies you'll work with

  • Android (Kotlin, Java) - primary platform for all POS application development
  • EMV payment standards and PCI/P2PE certification frameworks
  • Multiple POS device types and OEM manufacturers, including Topwise and Telpo
  • Terminal management systems and device observability tooling
  • Java, Spring Boot — backend services and integration layer
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch
  • Microservices architecture on AWS

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You will receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • Stage 1: A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
  • Stage 2: Technical Round focused on core technical strengths and depth in Android/Kotlin
  • Stage 3: System Design - You will be asked to solve complex system design problems to assess your technical and architectural skills, with a particular focus on POS and mobile platform architecture and payment systems.
  • Stage 4: Technical and Architectural Leadership - An interview with one Head of Engineering focused on leadership skills and attributes.
  • Stage 5: CTO Interview - A conversation with our CTO assessing first-principles thinking, problem-solving under ambiguity, clarity of thought, and cultural alignment.

How to apply: Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile via our career website.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates!

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer
jobs.excerpt: We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability.
jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Principal Product Designer – Infrastructure

Your opportunity

As a Principal Product Designer on New Relic's Infrastructure design team, you'll set the design vision for how engineers understand and operate the systems underneath their applications — cloud environments, Kubernetes, hosts, network performance (including eBPF-based instrumentation), and databases, partnering directly with VP- and SVP-level engineering and product leadership to shape a roadmap with measurable business impact. You'll work across the US and India to turn dense infrastructure telemetry into interfaces that hold up when something is actually on fire.

We care more about how you think than what you've already shipped. This role is built for someone with genuine, demonstrated curiosity about how complex technical systems work — someone who has a track record of digging into unfamiliar domains, asking good questions of engineers, and building real fluency rather than treating the underlying technology as a black box. Direct observability experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. The expectation for this role is someone who generates the ideas required to solve a problem even when it's ambiguous, and who leads through that complexity rather than waiting for someone else to define it.

You'll set craft and design-system standards across the Infrastructure design team, mentor senior and mid-level designers beyond a single direct pod, and be a visible design leader recognized by teams inside and outside the department as we evolve how we use AI in our own design workflow. This is a remote role based in India, working in close daily overlap with a US-based team.

What you'll do

  • Infrastructure & complex data visualization: Design dashboards and visualizations that make cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database telemetry legible — reducing cognitive load for engineers troubleshooting under pressure.
  • System coherence & fail-safe UX: Champion coherence across the Infrastructure surface, designing interaction patterns that guide platform engineers and SREs safely through incident response and root-cause investigation.
  • Own the product vision: Lead the creation of new product vision for Infrastructure with a clear line to business revenue impact, serving as the primary design point of contact across product, engineering, and go-to-market.
  • Go deep on the technology: Build real fluency in the systems you're designing for — cloud architecture, container orchestration, network protocols, eBPF, database internals — through direct conversations with engineers, hands-on exploration, and a genuine appetite for the technical detail most designers skip.
  • User research: Plan and run interviews and usability testing with SREs, platform engineers, and DevOps practitioners to validate design direction and keep the roadmap grounded in how these users actually work.
  • AI-forward evolution: Partner with engineering and product to bring AI-assisted diagnostics and anomaly detection into the infrastructure experience, applying the same curiosity to new AI tooling that you bring to the underlying systems.
  • Team leadership & craft: Set the craft bar across Infrastructure design, mentor senior and mid-level designers, and represent the team's design perspective directly to VP and SVP stakeholders.
  • Design at scale: Drive large-scale, cross-team design initiatives within Infrastructure, and partner with principal designers across Product Platform and Growth & Monetization to keep the broader platform coherent as it expands.

This role requires

  • 12+ years of professional experience in product or UX design, with a portfolio showing complex, data-heavy B2B SaaS or enterprise work.
  • Demonstrated, innate curiosity about technology — evidence that you've taught yourself unfamiliar technical domains in past roles, not just applied design process to whatever was handed to you.
  • Experience designing for technical personas (software engineers, SREs, DevOps, platform engineers), or a clear, credible path to ramping into this audience quickly.
  • Real skill in user research: interviews, usability testing, and synthesis that changes product direction, not just validates it.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to component-based design systems at scale, including a demonstrated ability to design systems-level solutions rather than instance by instance.
  • Solid grasp of WCAG 2.1 AA and assistive technologies, with the ability to independently troubleshoot accessibility issues and mentor others on accessible design practices.
  • Ability to connect design work to business outcomes — mapping initiatives to KPIs/OKRs and making the case for design decisions in terms product and engineering partners respect, including a track record of tying design work to measurable revenue impact, not just usability metrics.
  • Strong written and verbal English, and comfort working with a distributed team across US and India time zones.
  • A track record operating independently across multiple teams in a complex environment, with real experience partnering directly with VP- or SVP-level stakeholders on strategic initiatives.
  • An external professional presence in the design community — conferences, writing, mentorship beyond New Relic — consistent with the seniority of this level.

Bonus points if you have

  • Direct experience in observability, infrastructure monitoring, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), or adjacent developer-facing tooling.
  • Prior exposure to designing for AI-assisted or LLM-based tools, and comfort prototyping with AI-native tools (Figma AI, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
  • A working understanding of frontend fundamentals (HTML, CSS, React) that makes engineering handoff smoother.
  • Strong facilitation skills for cross-functional design sprints and workshops.

BUSINESS GOALS

This hire addresses cognitive overload during infrastructure incident response — the gap between a high-level "something's wrong" signal and the granular cloud, cluster, host, network, or database trace that explains why. As New Relic's Infrastructure suite absorbs more surface area (AI-agent observability, expanding eBPF coverage, deeper database monitoring), we need a design leader who can set a portfolio-level vision for that complexity — one with a credible line to business revenue and adoption, not just a well-designed feature. The end goal is the same one driving the whole design org right now: bringing AI into the diagnostic workflow to cut customer mean-time-to-resolution.

What are the key milestones or business outcomes this person must deliver in Year 1 to be considered a successful hire?

  1. Unify infrastructure workflows: audit and connect monitoring and mitigation pathways across cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database surfaces, establishing a portfolio-level design vision with measurable adoption and revenue impact, not just shared visual patterns.
  2. AI-assisted diagnostics: deliver initial UX architecture and human-in-the-loop interaction models for AI-assisted anomaly detection and root-cause analysis in Infrastructure.
  3. Process maturation: help standardize cross-functional design review between design, product, and engineering on complex telemetry pipelines (OpenTelemetry, eBPF-based instrumentation).
  4. Research cadence: stand up a continuous research loop with SREs and platform engineers to keep the roadmap grounded in real operating conditions, not assumptions.
  5. Executive partnership: build a working relationship with VP/SVP engineering and product leadership, and with peer principal designers across Product Platform and Growth & Monetization, so Infrastructure's design vision holds together with the rest of the platform.

  • Experience handling and protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

jobs.description:
Principal Product Manager

Location: Bengaluru, Coimbatore, India (Remote)

About AppViewX:

AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole’s 2025 Non-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.

Our Values

Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.

  • We Do What We Say: We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
  • We Are Trusted Experts: We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
  • We Raise the Bar: We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
  • We Win Together: We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to work with the Director of Product and help set the strategic direction for our Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) product line. This is a senior, high-impact individual contributor role: you will own the planning and execution for CLM, help shape company-level bets on where crypto-agility and CLM automation are headed, and act as the most senior product voice across a portfolio of related modules and initiatives.

You will operate with significant autonomy, partnering directly with engineering leadership, design, sales, and executive stakeholders to translate market and regulatory shifts into a coherent, differentiated roadmap. You will also raise the bar for the broader product organization, mentoring senior and mid-level PMs, setting standards for discovery and requirements gathering, and representing AppViewX’s CLM strategy with customers, and industry forums.

You bring deep product instincts, sharp executive and customer communication, and strong technical fluency in PKI and certificate management. You are comfortable operating ambiguously at the strategy layer while still being able to go deep into requirements, architecture trade-offs, and cross-functional execution when it matters most.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the roadmap for Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), aligning it with company strategy, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and enterprise customer needs.
  • Act as the senior product strategist for CLM, setting priorities across multiple modules and workstreams and ensuring coherence across the broader product portfolio.
  • Lead deep discovery engagements with enterprise customers, PKI architects, and customer stakeholders to surface strategic pain points around certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and visibility.
  • Translate complex regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, eIDAS, FIPS 140-2) into a coherent, forward-looking set of product capabilities and standards.
  • Define AppViewX’s point of view and product response to major industry shifts, including post-quantum cryptography (PQC), short-lived certificates (47-day validity), and Zero Trust models, working closely with engineering and architecture teams.
  • Set the bar for product requirements quality across the team, writing and reviewing PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the most complex, ambiguous, or cross-cutting initiatives.
  • Mentor and coach senior and mid-level PMs, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the overall maturity of product practices, documentation, and process across the organization.
  • Collaborate closely with Design on the end-to-end experience for certificate discovery, enrollment, renewal automation, and policy enforcement, ensuring consistency across a growing product portfolio.
  • Represent AppViewX’s CLM product strategy and roadmap externally with key customers, prospects, and at conferences or forums as needed.
  • Influence without direct authority across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and technical field teams aligning diverse stakeholders from individual contributors to the C-suite around a shared strategic direction.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 4+ years operating at a senior/lead or principal level owning strategy for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning product strategy end-to-end, from market analysis and vision-setting through execution, launch, and iteration at scale.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills; experienced with product analytics, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and using data to inform multi-quarter strategic bets.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence senior executives and align cross-functional stakeholders spanning engineering, design, technical sales, and leadership.
  • Significant experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government, telecoms), including direct engagement with security and compliance stakeholders.
  • Proven experience managing complex, API-first products and platform-level integrations.
  • Experience mentoring or leading other product managers, or otherwise operating as a force multiplier for a product organization.

Domain Expertise (Preferred):

Direct CLM or PKI leadership experience is strongly preferred. Candidates who can demonstrate the following will have a significant advantage:

  • Deep, strategic understanding of a CLM or PKI management platform, including X.509 certificate standards, certificate authorities (public and private), trust chains, and revocation mechanisms (CRL, OCSP).
  • Familiarity with certificate enrollment protocols: ACME, SCEP, EST, and REST-based CA APIs, and how they shape automation and integration strategy.
  • Experience setting strategy for automation workflows, and working knowledge of HSM (Hardware Security Module), key management, and cryptographic policy enforcement at an enterprise scale.

What’s more in store?

AppViewX is on par with leading global companies when it comes to the benefits it offers its employees, ranging from competitive incentives, health & wellness policies, saving & investment schemes, time off/sabbatical eligibility and dedicated L&D.

What we consider equally important is the flexibility we offer our employees to – work remotely, define their own hours, and more importantly harmonize both work and life. The more trust and accountability we place on our employees, the more they surpass our goals and expectations.

Why AppViewX?

AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.

AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.

This is a remote role, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a high-growth territory while helping to accelerate Fresha's expansion. You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging beauty and wellness businesses in your region, combining proactive field sales activity with a consultative approach to build strong local relationships and drive commercial success.

At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives. About the Role

The Director of Credentialing & Enrollment, plays a critical role at Eleanor Health in ensuring the organization’s credentialing and enrollment activities are accurate and compliant. This role provides strategic leadership over provider credentialing, privileging, and payer enrollment operations. This role ensures clinical staff meet regulatory standards, maintains compliance with bodies like NCQA and The Joint Commission, and optimizes workflows to ensure providers are credentialed and enrolled in a timely manner to support member care and revenue cycle continuity.

  • Direct the credentialing and payer enrollment departments, setting strategic goals, policies, and performance standards.

  • Clearly and effectively communicate with providers, Operations Managers and internal stakeholders handling basic questions dealing with the day-to-day operation of credentialing and enrollments
  • Identify, track, and mitigate compliance risks, escalating issues to senior leadership as needed.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry regulations and requirements, ensuring compliance at all times
  • Assist in preparing for and participating in audits and regulatory reviews

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in credentialing and/or payer enrollment, including at least 3 years in a leadership role

    Preferred:

  • Demonstrated ability to successfully lead process improvement projects
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to identify opportunities and drive effective strategies.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented mindset to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Adaptability and ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.

Compensation & Benefits

The total target compensation range for this position is $140,000-160,000. The actual compensation offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job.

Eleanor Health offers a generous benefits package to full-time employees, which includes:

  • Crear y priorizar backlog, user stories y criterios de aceptación considerando valor de negocio, riesgo, esfuerzo y viabilidad.
  • Participar en la definición de qué construir, qué no construir y por qué.

"Necesitamos a alguien que no reciba simplemente un requerimiento ya elaborado, sino que pueda descubrirlo, estructurarlo y traducirlo hacia producto y tecnología."

Client Solutions & Consulting

  • Actuar como interlocutor entre el cliente y el equipo de producto/ingeniería.
  • Facilitar workshops y sesiones con stakeholders operativos y directivos.
  • Traducir necesidades de negocio a lenguaje funcional y técnico, y hallazgos técnicos a decisiones comprensibles para el cliente.
  • Presentar alternativas de solución y explicar sus implicaciones en alcance, esfuerzo, riesgo, costo y tiempo.
  • Identificar oportunidades donde una solución digital o de IA pueda generar valor real para el cliente.
  • Mantener una relación consultiva con el cliente durante todo el proyecto, incluyendo conversaciones difíciles sobre prioridades, alcance, fechas y presupuesto.

Delivery & Project Ownership

  • Tomar ownership de proyectos digitales desde el Kick Off hasta el cierre y handover.
  • Coordinar el trabajo entre cliente, UX/UI, ingeniería y otros stakeholders.
  • Gestionar alcance, dependencias, riesgos, prioridades y desviaciones.
  • Trabajar con metodologías ágiles como Scrum y Kanban, utilizando la cadencia adecuada según las necesidades del proyecto.
  • Dar seguimiento al equipo técnico entendiendo la solución que se está construyendo, no únicamente el estatus de las tareas.
  • Detectar cambios de alcance y facilitar la evaluación de su impacto en esfuerzo, fechas y presupuesto.
  • Asegurar que el avance comunicado al cliente represente el avance real del producto.

AI aplicada al rol

Buscamos una persona que utilice IA más allá de generación de textos o documentación.

No necesitas ser AI Engineer ni tener experiencia entrenando modelos. Sí esperamos que puedas utilizar herramientas de IA como parte habitual de tu proceso de análisis y construcción de soluciones.

En la práctica, buscamos experiencia utilizando IA para:

  • Analizar y estructurar problemas complejos, información de Discovery y procesos de negocio.
  • Explorar alternativas de solución y acelerar la definición funcional de productos.
  • Construir prototipos funcionales, demos, automatizaciones, workflows o agentes que permitan validar una idea antes de comprometer desarrollo.
  • Experimentar rápidamente con una hipótesis y utilizar el resultado para tomar decisiones de producto.
  • Identificar procesos del cliente que puedan beneficiarse de automatización o soluciones basadas en IA.
  • Evaluar de manera inicial si un caso de uso de IA tiene sentido considerando impacto de negocio, viabilidad, riesgo y time-to-value.
  • Utilizar prompting estructurado y trabajar de manera iterativa, validando críticamente las respuestas generadas.
  • Utilizar IA para apoyar análisis, especificación y documentación, manteniendo siempre revisión y criterio humano sobre el resultado.

Importante: usar ChatGPT, Claude u otras herramientas únicamente para redactar correos, resumir reuniones o generar user stories NO representa por sí solo el nivel de experiencia en IA que buscamos.

Perfil:

  • 5+ años de experiencia profesional en Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, consultoría digital o gestión de proyectos de software.
  • Experiencia comprobable definiendo producto, no únicamente coordinando su ejecución.
  • Haber participado directamente en decisiones sobre qué construir, cómo priorizarlo y por qué.
  • Experiencia levantando necesidades y transformándolas en requerimientos, funcionalidades y flujos de producto.
  • Capacidad para comprender y analizar procesos de negocio.
  • Experiencia trabajando directamente con clientes externos, idealmente conduciendo Discovery, workshops o sesiones de levantamiento.
  • Experiencia trabajando de manera cercana con UX/UI y equipos de ingeniería.
  • Experiencia llevando soluciones de software desde definición hasta entrega.
  • Conocimiento suficiente de conceptos de software, integraciones y APIs para mantener conversaciones efectivas con equipos técnicos.
  • Experiencia práctica utilizando IA para análisis, prototipado, automatización o construcción/validación de soluciones.
  • Inglés B2–C1 conversacional, con capacidad para conducir sesiones de trabajo con clientes sin apoyo.

Deseable

  • Experiencia previa como Product Manager en startup, scale-up, SaaS o productos digitales.
  • Experiencia en consultoría de tecnología, producto o transformación digital.
  • Experiencia documentando y optimizando procesos mediante BPMN, process mapping, swimlanes u otras metodologías.
  • Experiencia con herramientas no-code / low-code y AI-assisted development para construir prototipos o automatizaciones.
  • Familiaridad con asistentes de desarrollo basados en IA y con la forma de trabajo de equipos de ingeniería.
  • Conocimiento general de infraestructura cloud, plataformas de terceros y costos asociados a soluciones digitales.
  • Experiencia previa en una industria o vertical específica será valorada, pero no es requisito.

El perfil que mejor puede encajar

Puedes venir de diferentes trayectorias. Nos interesa especialmente conversar con:

  • Product Managers de startups, scale-ups, SaaS o compañías de producto que hayan tenido ownership real sobre funcionalidades o productos.
  • Product Consultants / Digital Consultants acostumbrados a entender problemas de clientes y convertirlos en soluciones.
  • Senior Product Owners con fuerte exposición a negocio, cliente e ingeniería.
  • Senior Business Analysts que hayan evolucionado más allá del levantamiento de requerimientos y participado en definición de solución y producto.
  • Project Managers con experiencia demostrable tomando decisiones de producto y negocio, no únicamente gestionando delivery.

La industria de origen no es restrictiva. Nos importa más la capacidad de aprender un negocio, comprender sus procesos y convertirlos en una solución que venir de una vertical determinada.

Probablemente no sea el rol adecuado si...

  • Tu experiencia se concentra principalmente en Jira, ceremonias, seguimiento de tareas y métricas de sprint.

jobs.title: Rev/Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

About the Role

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, the Rev/Marketing Operations Manager owns HubSpot end to end — the instance, the data model, and the daily campaign build — and is the architect of how Agility measures marketing's impact on revenue.
Our attribution challenge is real and unsolved: our CRM lifecycle doesn't follow the textbook pattern, so conventional attribution models don't work here out of the box. You will establish HubSpot as the initial source of truth for marketing data, design a measurement approach that fits how our systems actually behave, evaluate first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch attribution in HubSpot, and make a defensible recommendation. Just as important as building the model is explaining it: you will articulate the methodology — clearly and credibly — to the VP of Marketing, the broader organization, and our sales partners.

This is a builder's seat, not an administrator's. You will build and launch campaigns in HubSpot on a daily basis, executing on behalf of the Associate Director, Demand Generation, who sets campaign priorities and briefs; you own build quality, instance governance, and measurement truth. You will partner closely with our Salesforce Administrator on the CRM boundary.

This role reports directly to the Director of Marketing — deliberately outside the campaign organization — so that measurement remains independent and credible with every stakeholder it serves.

You will also instrument our conversational AI pilot, including capturing baseline website conversion rates before go-live, so that the pilot's impact is measured honestly from day one.

What Success Looks Like

  • A recommended attribution model (first-touch, last-touch, or multi-touch) is implemented in HubSpot, documented, and understood by marketing, sales, and leadership — with the methodology presented and defended in plain language.
  • HubSpot operates as the initial source of truth for marketing data, reconciled cleanly with the Salesforce contact structure.
  • Campaigns ship daily and weekly — on brief, on time, and to a quality standard — in support of demand generation priorities.
  • Email compliance runs clean across all regional lanes — CAN-SPAM (US), CASL (Canada), GDPR/PECR (UK-EU) — with zero compliance incidents.
  • The conversational AI pilot has a documented pre-launch conversion baseline and live measurement of its impact on conversion and meetings booked.
  • Lead scoring, routing, and lifecycle workflows are rebuilt, documented, and trusted by sales.

What You'll Do

Attribution & Measurement

  • Design and implement Agility's marketing attribution model in HubSpot, working within the realities of our CRM lifecycle rather than the textbook version.
  • Evaluate first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch approaches; recommend one and defend the trade-offs.
  • Present the methodology and its reporting to marketing, sales, and executive stakeholders, and iterate based on what the business needs to see.
  • Build and maintain the dashboards leadership uses to make budget decisions — and be able to dissect and rebuild any dashboard from the underlying data.

Campaign Build & Execution

  • Build, QA, launch, and monitor campaigns in HubSpot daily on behalf of the Associate Director, Demand Generation: emails, nurtures, workflows, forms, landing pages, lists, and segmentation.
  • Operate the regional outbound email lanes and their differing consent regimes.
  • Own campaign build quality end to end: deliverability, rendering, tracking, and data hygiene.

Platform Governance & Compliance

  • Own the HubSpot instance: architecture, permissions, integrations, data model, naming conventions, and documentation.
  • Own compliance operations across CAN-SPAM, CASL, and GDPR/PECR, including consent management, suppression, and auditability.
  • Partner with the Salesforce Administrator on the HubSpot–Salesforce boundary: sync health, field mapping, and the lead lifecycle handoff.
  • Design and maintain routing and SLA flows for our no-SDR motion, including the chatbot-to-calendar handoff.
  • Operate the dedicated cold-outbound sending stack alongside HubSpot — domain and mailbox health, warmup, and bidirectional sync (suppression lists out, activity and replies in) — keeping true cold email off the marketing platform in line with its acceptable-use policy.
  • Maintain the data-rights workflow: a documented path to delete or suppress a contact across HubSpot, the outbound sequencer, and enrichment exports.

AI & Pilot Measurement

  • Instrument the conversational AI pilot: capture the pre-launch website conversion baseline, define success metrics, and report pilot performance.
  • Apply HubSpot's current AI capabilities — such as Breeze, AI-assisted workflows, and predictive scoring — where they demonstrably improve speed or quality.
  • Continuously evaluate new HubSpot releases and recommend adoption where warranted.

Why You'll Bring

  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot expertise — administration, campaign build, reporting, and data model — in a live production instance (Marketing Hub required; HubSpot certifications an asset).
  • Demonstrated fluency with HubSpot's current AI and agentic capabilities (for example Breeze, AI-assisted workflows, and predictive scoring), applied in production — this platform evolves monthly, and you keep pace.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and experience managing a HubSpot–Salesforce integration, with the comfort to design around non-standard CRM structures.
  • Proven attribution experience: you have built — not just read — attribution reporting, and you can explain the trade-offs of competing models to non-technical audiences.
  • Email compliance experience across at least two of CAN-SPAM, CASL, and GDPR.
  • Experience operating or supporting a dedicated cold-email stack — sequencer, secondary sending domains, warmup, deliverability monitoring — and syncing it cleanly with a CRM.
  • An analyst's mindset: you dissect dashboards down to the underlying data, rebuild what's broken, and treat measurement accuracy as a matter of professional pride.
  • A sense of urgency and a test-and-learn habit: you review the numbers weekly, form hypotheses, and iterate.

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Collaborative culture – and key tools enabling it
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Health, Dental & Vision benefits
  • RRSP matching
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career Development & Progression opportunities
  • Paid Vacation, Personal Days and Sick days
  • Flex Fridays in Summer, Week off between Christmas and New Years'
  • No Internal Meetings Fridays

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is C$82,000–C$115,000 annually, plus a 10% target bonus. Final compensation will reflect the successful candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity.

This is a new position.

AI Usage

We use technology to make hiring smarter, faster, and more personal, never less human. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools help us manage applications efficiently and highlight qualifications that align with each role, allowing our recruiters to focus more on meaningful conversations with candidates. AI does not make hiring decisions at Agility. Every decision is made by people, our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are trained to apply sound judgment and equitable practices at every stage. We believe technology exists to amplify human insight, not replace it. That belief shapes how we build relationships, tell stories, and grow our teams.

At Agility, we strive every day to build a more inclusive work environment and introduce tools that enable it. We strongly encourage applications from all people regardless of race, religion, gender, age, disability status or sexual orientation.

Even if you find yourself not checking all the boxes of our listed requirements but you are excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you anyway. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application for this role, and other potential role matches open now or in the future.

If, at any stage of the application process, you require accommodation owing to disability or a medical need, please let us know at for us to make appropriate arrangements.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Rockstaris hiring a full-time Front Desk & Customer Service Virtual Assistant on behalf of an animal welfare nonprofit serving a large rural service area.

This organization currently fields all inbound calls and email inquiries through a small front desk team, calls that are often emotional and urgent: found animals, injured pets, behavior crises, lost and found reports, and general questions about shelter services. Many callers are older or don't have reliable internet access, so phone remains their primary way of reaching the organization.

This role is not a message-passing position. The VA needs to actually resolve inquiries on the call itself using established scripts and procedures, not just relay information back to staff. As the organization launches new proactive programs over the coming months, this role also has real potential to expand into supporting those initiatives directly.

About the Client

This organization is an animal shelter serving a large, primarily rural community, taking in thousands of animals each year. They are shifting from a reactive to a proactive model of care, actively developing new outreach and prevention programs so their in-person team can focus more directly on hands-on animal care.

Their culture is mission-driven, organized, and deeply compassionate, with clear documented procedures already in place to support a new team member coming in.

Key Responsibilities

Phone & Customer Service

  • Answer all inbound calls related to lost and found animals, fostering, volunteering, general shelter procedures, and behavior or medical helpline questions
  • De-escalate emotionally distressed callers with genuine empathy and a calm, professional tone
  • Resolve inquiries directly on the call using established scripts and escalation guidelines, rather than simply taking a message
  • Direct calls appropriately across departments according to documented SOPs

Email & Administrative Support

  • Manage the organization's general inbox, responding to the same categories of inquiries handled by phone (fostering, volunteering, procedures, lost and found)
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation within the shelter management system (ShelterLuv), with training provided

Program Support (Growth Opportunity)

  • As new organizational programs launch, potentially support scheduling for community outreach initiatives, such as trap-neuter-return voucher distribution and owned-pet retention support

Tools & Systems

  • Sangoma (VoIP phone system)
  • ShelterLuv (shelter management software, training provided)
  • Email

Requirements

  • Strong phone-based customer service experience required
  • Genuine empathy and strong de-escalation skills, callers are frequently in emotional distress
  • Comfortable resolving issues independently rather than simply forwarding messages
  • Animal welfare background or a genuine love of animals is a strong plus
  • Comfortable learning new administrative software
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to follow documented procedures closely

Non-Negotiables

  • Strong empathy and de-escalation skills
  • Ability to solve problems on the call rather than just relaying messages
  • Reliable and consistent, this organization depends on the front line being covereda

Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth.
  • Work in a dynamic and supportive team environment.

About Us

Pomelo places the best offshore talent with top brands, startups, and agencies across the globe. We enable hard-working and ambitious talent to work remotely from their home countries, while gaining exposure into how the world’s top companies operate.

About the Role

Our client is a culturally-conscious talent management agency that celebrates Black digital talent. They are seeking an Outreach Specialist to drive the offensive side of their sales engine. This role is responsible for everything they earn by going out and getting it: targeted LinkedIn outreach, casting submissions, brand and platform applications, and the daily care and feeding of our AI pitching infrastructure.

This is a volume role with judgment. You will move quickly across many opportunities a day, conduct disciplined LinkedIn outreach to brand and agency contacts, submit castings on behalf of our roster, fill out brand application forms, manage outputs from our AI pitching tooling, and keep the pipeline of net-new conversations alive. Warm replies hand off to the Brand Partnerships Specialist for negotiation and close.

Responsibilities

  • Run High-Volume Castings. Submit roughly 20 well-matched castings per day on behalf of our roster. Read briefs closely, choose the right talent, attach the correct materials, and write a short, persuasive submission note that reflects each creator's voice.
  • Drive LinkedIn Outreach. Conduct targeted LinkedIn outreach to brand marketers, agency leads, and decision-makers. Personalize meaningfully, track every touch, and convert connections into qualified conversations.
  • Complete Platform Forms and Applications. Apply talent and the agency to brand opportunities, accelerator programs, and platform-driven open calls. Treat every form as a pitch, not a checkbox.
  • Pitch with Story, Not Stats. Write short, sharp storytelling pitches that lead with the creator's narrative and category fit, not generic stats. You will be given a clear brand voice and brand examples to model from.
  • Manage AI-Assisted Pitching. Monitor, refine, and clean outputs from our AI pitching tooling daily. Ensure every machine-generated message reflects agency voice, accurate talent positioning, and current brand priorities. AI is your accelerant, not your auto-pilot.
  • Maintain the Outbound Record. Keep a clear, dated record of who has been pitched, what they responded with, and when to re-engage. Hand off warm replies to the Brand Partnerships Specialist with full context.
  • Spot Opportunity Lanes. Identify category gaps, brand whitespace, and seasonal moments where the roster is underexposed and proactively build pitch lists against them. Think in waves, not single touches.
  • Report Cleanly. Provide a clear weekly summary to the Principal: castings submitted, LinkedIn touches, applications filed, AI pitches sent, replies received, and any patterns worth attention.

Qualifications

  • 1–3+ years of experience in influencer marketing, PR, talent management, brand partnerships outreach, or a comparable outbound role.
  • Excellent professional written English. Native or near-native fluency required.
  • Strong short-form writing skills — you can write a 75-word pitch or LinkedIn message that reads like a person, not a template.
  • Demonstrated comfort with LinkedIn outreach at volume — targeting, personalization, and disciplined follow-up cadences.
  • Fluency with AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) used for outbound work. Bonus for experience with dedicated outbound tooling (Smartlead, Apollo, or comparable).
  • Familiarity with influencer casting platforms, brand application forms, and the broader creator economy ecosystem.
  • Organized, self-directed, and comfortable working from a daily / weekly output dashboard.
  • Reliable, professional remote work setup with stable internet and the ability to take calls when needed.
  • Overlap with US Eastern Time hours required.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay, always in US dollars
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your home
  • Health & wellness benefit
  • Paid holidays and time off
  • Performance and referral bonuses
  • Global exposure to the world’s best companies

This is a fast-paced, operations-focused role where you’ll help ensure tenant communication remains organized, leasing processes stay compliant, maintenance requests are resolved efficiently, and property records remain accurate and up to date.

You’ll serve as the operational link between tenants, property owners, vendors, and internal property management teams to ensure smooth portfolio operations and an exceptional tenant experience.

If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, experienced with property management systems, and enjoy coordinating multiple moving parts, this role is an excellent fit.

What You’ll Own

Tenant Communication & Support

  • Respond to tenant inquiries regarding rent payments, lease terms, maintenance requests, and property policies.
  • Maintain detailed communication records within property management platforms.
  • Send reminders for rent due dates, lease renewals, inspections, and compliance notices.
  • Deliver professional, timely, and customer-focused support throughout the tenant lifecycle.

Leasing & Documentation

  • Process new lease agreements, renewals, amendments, and tenant onboarding documentation.
  • Maintain organized tenant files, including applications, identification, inspection reports, and signed agreements.
  • Ensure leasing documentation remains complete, accurate, and compliant.
  • Assist with property listings across platforms such as Zillow, Apartments.com, MLS, and similar listing services.

Property Management Systems

  • Maintain accurate records within platforms such as Yardi, AppFolio, Buildium, or similar systems.
  • Track rent collections, delinquencies, occupancy changes, late fees, and lease expirations.
  • Generate operational reports including rent rolls, occupancy reports, delinquency summaries, and leasing activity.

Maintenance Coordination

  • Create and assign maintenance work orders to vendors.
  • Monitor maintenance requests from submission through completion.
  • Coordinate communication between tenants and vendors.
  • Verify completed work and reconcile vendor invoices against approved work orders.
  • Ensure maintenance issues are resolved promptly and professionally.

Owner Reporting & Operational Support

  • Prepare owner statements, cash flow summaries, vacancy reports, and occupancy updates.
  • Provide regular updates on rent collections, maintenance activity, leasing progress, and property performance.
  • Ensure reports are accurate, organized, and delivered on schedule.

Compliance & Quality Control

  • Maintain compliance with landlord-tenant regulations, Fair Housing standards, and internal company procedures.
  • Ensure all documentation remains organized, complete, and audit-ready.
  • Support operational consistency through accurate recordkeeping and process adherence.

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in property management, leasing coordination, real estate operations, or property administration.
  • Hands-on experience using Yardi, AppFolio, Buildium, or similar property management software.
  • Experience with lease administration, tenant communication, rent collection tracking, and maintenance coordination.

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
  • Familiarity with lease documentation, property operations, and reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-volume environment.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience managing portfolios of 100+ units.
  • Multi-state property management experience.
  • Familiarity with owner statements, trust accounting, and security deposit management.
  • Experience supporting residential, commercial, or mixed-use property portfolios.

Tools & Platforms

  • Yardi
  • AppFolio
  • Buildium
  • Microsoft Office
  • Google Workspace
  • Zillow
  • Apartments.com
  • MLS Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Excellent communicator with tenants, vendors, and property owners.
  • Highly organized with strong follow-through.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven.
  • Comfortable managing multiple operational workflows simultaneously.
  • Solutions-focused with strong operational judgment.
  • Thrives in fast-paced property management environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Respond to tenant inquiries and maintenance requests.
  • Process leases, renewals, and tenant documentation.
  • Update rent payments and occupancy records.
  • Coordinate vendors and monitor maintenance work orders.
  • Prepare owner reports and operational summaries.
  • Maintain accurate records within property management systems.
  • Ensure compliance across leasing and operational processes.

In short: You keep property operations organized, compliant, and running efficiently by coordinating leasing, maintenance, tenant communication, and operational reporting.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Rent collection percentage
  • Vacancy fill time
  • Maintenance resolution turnaround time
  • Accuracy of lease and tenant documentation
  • Owner satisfaction with reporting and communication
  • Operational accuracy and system data integrity

Why This Role Stands Out

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

jobs.excerpt: At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose.
jobs.description:
At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose. We champion the power and potential of nonprofits, igniting next-level impact with the team and technology built for purpose. Our powerful giving platform and stellar support enable tens of thousands of nonprofits to raise more, recruit more, and retain more, fueling maximum impact and raising the bar on what’s possible for the nonprofit sector. That's why, even as the nonprofit sector sees declines in giving, Bloomerang customers raise more year over year.

We're also in the business of creating thriving employees. Join a mission-driven culture built on our core values of Simplify, Care and Act. We know our people are the key to our success, and we're proud to be home to some of the most innovative and skilled individuals in the workforce today. Come feel invigorated and unstoppable with us!

The Role

We are evolving our Tier 3 Support Engineering team into a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) organization focused on improving product reliability, observability, and operational efficiency. We're looking for an experienced SRE who brings strong software engineering fundamentals and is excited to help shape this transformation and mature our SRE practices.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role working across application code, telemetry, databases, APIs, and infrastructure to diagnose complex production issues and improve reliability. Production support and product defects remain part of today's work as you help reduce reactive effort through observability, SLOs, automation, permanent fixes, and proactive reliability engineering.

What Success Looks Like

Success isn't measured solely by issues resolved, but by issues that no longer require manual intervention. You'll help detect problems earlier, reduce recurring issues and toil, strengthen incident response, and create more capacity for proactive reliability engineering.

What You Will Do

  • Own complex production support escalations and ticket triage, providing hands-on troubleshooting and resolution alongside reliability work.
  • Partner with Software Engineering to investigate complex production issues, identify root causes and reliability risks, and drive permanent solutions to recurring problems and defects.
  • Bring proven SRE practices to the team and foster proactive reliability, continuous improvement, automation, and shared ownership.
  • Lead incident response from triage and mitigation through recovery, root cause analysis, and blameless post-incident reviews, turning lessons learned into reliability improvements.
  • Build observability across products, services, and critical customer workflows using meaningful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts.
  • Define and mature SLIs and SLOs that measure system reliability and customer experience.
  • Develop synthetic monitoring for critical customer journeys to detect failures before they impact customers.
  • Identify sources of recurring operational toil and drive automation, tooling, process improvements, or permanent fixes that reduce manual effort.
  • Use AI-assisted tools and source code repositories to accelerate triage, troubleshooting, code analysis, automation, and technical investigation.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule, primarily during business hours, with limited after-hours and weekend support.

What You Need to Succeed

SRE Experience & Transformation

  • Hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience applying software engineering practices to production reliability and helping establish or mature SRE practices.
  • Strong knowledge of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, automation, and toil reduction.

Observability & Incident Management

  • Experience building monitoring, dashboards, alerts, and telemetry using tools such as Honeycomb, New Relic, Grafana, CloudWatch, Kibana, or similar.
  • Experience with production incident management, root cause analysis, blameless post-incident reviews, and corrective-action follow-through.

Technical Depth

  • Strong programming and scripting skills to navigate and troubleshoot application code and build automation and operational tooling.
  • Strong SQL and relational database skills for production troubleshooting and safe data correction; PostgreSQL experience preferred.
  • Strong code literacy and debugging skills, including navigating unfamiliar codebases, understanding application flow, reviewing code and change history, and identifying potential reliability issues.
  • Experience troubleshooting cloud-hosted applications using source code, logs, APIs, telemetry, event streams, and databases. Comfort navigating application stacks across technologies such as PHP, .NET, and Node.js; deep expertise in each is not required.

AI, Ownership & Collaboration

  • Demonstrated experience using and embracing AI-assisted tools in day-to-day engineering workflows, including troubleshooting, code analysis, scripting, and automation.
  • A collaborative self-starter who tackles difficult problems, adapts to changing priorities, and challenges the status quo.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across Software Engineering, Product, Support, DevOps, and other technical teams.

Benefits

Health + Wellness
You’ll have access to generous health, vision, and dental insurance options as well as HealthiestYou, a healthcare service that offers convenient, confidential access to quality doctors 24/7, anytime, anywhere.

Time Off
You'll get a competitive PTO package that includes 20 PTO days, 3 flex days, 4 optional volunteer days, 12 paid holidays, as well as paid parental leave. More is more!

401kYou'll receive a 401k match to help invest in your future.

Equipment
Everything you need to be successful, shipped right to your door. You got this. We got you.

Compensation
The salary range for this position is $114,800 - $150,000. You may also be eligible for a discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, as well as applicable employment laws

Location
This is a permanent, full-time, fully remote position (within the U.S. and select Canadian Provinces only). Employees living in Indianapolis, IN are welcome to work from our company headquarters. We do not offer Visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

AccommodationsApplicants who require accommodations may contact to request an accommodation in completing an application.

Bloomerang is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Individuals seeking employment at Bloomerang are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

jobs.excerpt: Join the Rest RevolutionThe world is wired and tired.
jobs.description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

Ten years ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Opportunity

Hatch is seeking a creative, versatile Senior Producer to lead the production of premium audio experiences across our content portfolio - from meditations and sleep music to bedtime podcasts, audiobooks, and ASMR.

This is a hands-on creative role for someone who can move fluidly between disciplines. You might write or edit a meditation script, cast and direct a narrator, give a musician notes on a sound bath, assemble a rough cut in Pro Tools, or lead a project from early concept through launch.

You have exceptional instincts for pacing, tone, story, talent, and sound - and the ear to know when something is (or isn’t) working and why. You bring a strong creative point of view, but you’re equally comfortable collaborating, experimenting, and adapting your approach to the needs of a project.

This role will report to the Director of Audio Production.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead audio projects from concept through launch, owning the creative vision, production plan, and final execution.
  • Write, edit, and shape scripts across storytelling, mindfulness, and other audio formats, ensuring a strong, cohesive voice aligned with Hatch’s brand identity.
  • Source, cast, onboard and direct narrators, hosts, practitioners, musicians and other creative talent.
  • Develop pilots, test new formats, and evolve existing franchises across the Hatch content library.
  • Build strong relationships with talent and create an environment where they can do their best work.
  • Build and manage production schedules in Airtable, keeping projects moving without sacrificing creative quality.
  • Work with Director of Production to resource projects effectively across internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate early and often with Strategy, Development, Marketing, Design, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Direct recording sessions and talent, and jump into Pro Tools to edit, assemble, score, or lightly sound design work when needed.
  • Partner closely with sound designers, engineers, composers, and musicians to shape music and sound design.
  • Anticipate what a project needs beyond the audio itself, from the metadata to the marketing assets to artwork and launch deliverables, and make sure the right people have the right context at the right time.
  • Assemble rough cuts, give clear and actionable creative feedback, and ensure final audio meets Hatch’s quality bar.
  • Perform final quality control (QC) checks on all audio for platform and device playback.
  • Maintain a high and consistent creative bar across the Hatch content library while helping evolve what Hatch audio can sound and feel like.

What Success Looks Like

Within 1 month:

  • Get to know the team, our production workflows, and the Hatch content library
  • Understand what’s currently in production and what’s coming next
  • Take the lead on at least one active project
  • Identify opportunities to make our production processes stronger or more efficient.

Within 3 Months:

  • Independently lead projects from concept through delivery.
  • Deliver high-quality pilots, scripts, and audio.
  • Successfully launch your first project.
  • Regularly contribute new creative ideas and opportunities for the slate.

After 6 Months:

  • Develop new content that meaningfully strengthens and expands Hatch’s brand identity.
  • Help evolve existing franchises and identify opportunities for new ones.
  • Identify and experiment with new approaches to audio, sound, light, and production workflows.
  • Be a trusted creative leader and collaborator across the content team.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of hands-on audio production experience: Proficiency in writing, recording, directing, and editing high-quality audio. You know when to do something yourself vs bring in a specialist.
  • Strong Creative Point of View: You have exceptional taste and a proven body of work to back it up. You use that point of view as a North Star while adapting to the audience, function, and creative language of each project.
  • Excellent writing and editorial instincts. Regardless of subject matter, you understand tone, structure, pacing, and voice. You can make a script better on the page, and continue shaping it with talent in the room.
  • A track record of great casting and talent development: Whether your working with hosts, actors, practitioners, experts, influencers, or artists, you know how to find interesting people and get their best work - not simply direct them.
  • A strong musical ear. You’re comfortable giving informed, specific feedback on music-forward content, and collaborating with professional musicians, composers, singers, and sound designers.
  • A full-court view: You see a project from beginning to end and stay ahead of what it needs at every stage. You bring in the right stakeholders early, communicate the right context, and make sure both the content and everything surrounding it are delivered on time and positioned for impact.
  • A team player mentality: You make the people around you better, teach generously, give clear feedback, celebrate great work, and identify opportunities for others to grow. You believe that the best creative teams operate as teams, not collections of individuals.
  • A bias to action: You’re creative, organized, communicative, and willing to step up and lead without being asked.
  • Fearlessness and curiosity: You like learning new tools, testing unfamiliar workflows, and challenging the way things have always been done.
  • Fluency with modern creative tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Granola, and other AI tools are already part of your workflow - or you’re eager to make them part of it. You’re thoughtful about where these tools can make creative work sharper, faster, and more collaborative.
  • Exceptional communication: You know how much context people need and when they need it. You communicate clearly with creative collaborators, cross-functional stakeholders, and leadership without over- or under- explaining, and you delegate with clarity.

Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch

  • We’re a certified Great Place to Work
  • We help people sleep better. Our products make a real, meaningful difference in our customers’ lives
  • Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds, and you’ll work with leadership that truly values every contribution
  • We’re backed by world-class investors (and growing fast)
  • We’re a remote-friendly work environment. We practice what we preach to give our employees better balance and more flexibility

The Perks & Benefits That Matter

  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees (80% for dependents, including domestic partners)
  • Meaningful equity. You’re an owner here
  • 401(k) match with no vesting schedule
  • 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave
  • 16 free therapy sessions (for you and one other adult in your life)
  • Financial support for family planning
  • Remote office and monthly internet reimbursement
  • Friends and family discounts on Hatch products
  • Exclusive discounts on travel, entertainment, and top retail brands

About Hatch

Hatch was founded in 2014 by entrepreneurs (and parents themselves) Ann Crady Weiss and Dave Weiss. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Hatch creates tech that helps you and your family get better sleep.

Hatch Sleep Clock is a contactless sleep tracker that provides actionable insights, personalized recommendations, and bedtime routines based on your unique sleep habits and preferences

  • Restore 3 helps you regulate your nervous system and tune into your circadian rhythm with unwind routines, science-backed sleep audio, and ambient lights
  • Hatch Baby helps parents soothe their little ones and create healthy sleep habits with expert sleep support, gentle sounds, and calming lights
  • Hatch Go includes ten soothing sounds in one portable package

We’re an equal opportunity employer and committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Ready to Help the World Sleep Better?

We’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join us in making great sleep a reality for all.
